contentBlocks.heading: The Gurgaon school calendar that sets every tuition timetable
contentBlocks.body:
Families at international schools across Gurgaon work to a calendar that nobody publishes in one place. Pathways World School, Aravali; Pathways School Gurgaon; Lancers International School; Scottish High International School; GD Goenka World School; Heritage Xperiential Learning School; The Shri Ram School, Aravali; and DPS International Edge are among the names parents mention when they call. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named here, the International Baccalaureate, Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel, and nothing on this page describes what any particular school offers.

What matters for planning is the shape of the year. Most Gurgaon IB schools enter students for the May session; November is used by a minority of schools and by retake candidates. Each school sets its own DP2 mock examination dates, usually several months before May, and those dates are the single most useful thing a parent can give a tutor at the first conversation. May results are released in early July, which is also when families discover whether a retake conversation is needed.

Bus timings decide more than parents credit. A child on a long route home from an Aravali-side campus reaches a flat on the Dwarka Expressway much later than a child walking home in Sushant Lok, and a tutor arriving at the theoretical hour then sits in the drawing room. Give the real arrival time, not the bell time. Add the days with sport, music or a club, because a session squeezed against one of those produces a tired forty minutes rather than a working hour.

Internal deadlines pile up in a way the exam calendar does not show. IA drafts, the Extended Essay milestones, TOK work and the MYP Personal Project all land during term, often close to unit tests. A tutor who has those dates written down in week one plans around them; a tutor who learns about them the night before does not.
items: Give the tutor the real bus arrival time, not the school's closing bell
Share the school's own DP2 mock dates at the first conversation
List sport, music and club evenings before the slot is fixed
Write down IA, EE, TOK and Personal Project deadlines in week one
Most Gurgaon IB schools use the May session; November suits a minority
IB Gram is not affiliated with any school, board or examination body

contentBlocks.heading: Home classes, live online or hybrid: which one suits your corridor?
contentBlocks.body:
Home tuition is the default and the reason most Gurgaon parents search in the first place. A tutor at the dining table sees the working, not just the answer, catches a misread question in the moment, and cannot be muted by a weak connection. For PYP and younger MYP students it is close to essential, because attention at that age holds better with a person in the room than with a face on a laptop. The cost is travel: a home tutor's evening holds two or three addresses at most, so the good slots go early.

Live online suits DP students, specialist subjects and difficult corridors. It removes the trip entirely, which matters in Gwal Pahari, Bhondsi, IMT Manesar and the far Dwarka Expressway sectors, and it opens up tutors who would never drive to your sector twice a week. Annotated past papers on a shared screen work genuinely well for Mathematics and the sciences. Discussion-heavy work, an essay plan talked through, or a student who drifts the moment nobody is beside them, work less well.

Hybrid is the arrangement most families settle into by the second term: one session at home each week to set direction and mark work face to face, one online for practice, revision or doubt-solving. It survives a bad traffic week without cancelling anything, and it keeps the relationship personal enough that the student still turns up prepared.

The plain trade-off, stated once: home tuition buys attention and loses flexibility; online tuition buys flexibility and choice of tutor but loses some attention; hybrid keeps most of both and asks the family to run two slightly different routines in one week. Choose by corridor and by the student's age, not by preference in the abstract.
items: Home classes: strongest for PYP and younger MYP students who drift online
Online: opens specialist tutors your corridor cannot reach twice a week
Hybrid: one home session to direct the work, one online for practice
Far sectors and late slots usually argue for a screen, not a car
Shared annotated past papers suit Mathematics and the sciences online
A missed home session converts to online the same evening more often than not

contentBlocks.heading: What is checked before an IB home tutor rings your doorbell?
contentBlocks.body:
Before any profile is shortlisted, IB Gram verifies identity and qualification documents and checks the boards and levels the tutor claims to teach. That is the floor, not the ceiling. A verified profile tells you the person is who they say they are and has taught what they say they have taught. It does not tell you whether this particular adult will hold your particular fourteen-year-old's attention on a Wednesday evening, which is why a demo or trial session exists.

There are checks only a parent can make, and they take a few minutes. Ask which level the tutor has taught most recently and for how long, at HL or SL, or which MYP years. Ask which criteria or which papers they have marked work against. Ask them to describe how they would approach the exact topic your child is stuck on, and listen for whether the answer is about the syllabus or about generic study technique. Ask what they will send you after each session.

Home lessons add practical questions. Agree where the tutor will sit and which room is used, keep the lesson in a part of the house with a door that stays open or a line of sight from elsewhere, and register the tutor at the society gate as a regular visitor so entry is not renegotiated every week. In DLF Park Place or Central Park Resorts that registration takes one visit to the facility office. In a builder floor in Sector 45 it takes a phone call to the guard.

Keep the arrangement written down in a message, even informally: days, duration, what happens to a cancelled session, and how a replacement will be handled if the tutor is unwell. Families rarely regret writing it; they regret not having it in February.
items: Identity and qualification documents are verified before a profile is shortlisted
Ask which level and which years the tutor has most recently taught
Ask how they would teach the exact topic your child is stuck on
Register the tutor once at the society gate as a regular visitor
Keep the lesson in a room with an open door or clear line of sight
Put days, duration and cancellation terms in a message before session one

contentBlocks.heading: Which Gurgaon corridors pair naturally in one tutor's week
contentBlocks.body:
The Southern Peripheral Road corridor, covering Sector 66, Sector 67, Sector 68, Sector 69, Sector 70, Sector 72, Ansal Esencia, Bhondsi and societies such as Tata Primanti, pairs cleanly with Golf Course Extension Road. A tutor holding Sector 65 and Sector 67 on the same evening barely changes direction. Bhondsi and Ansal Esencia sit further out, and a family there should expect either a weekend slot or a mostly online arrangement rather than a Tuesday at half past six.

New Gurgaon, meaning Sector 82, Sector 83, Sector 84, Sector 85, Sector 86, Sector 89, Sector 90, Kherki Daula and Pataudi Road, with Vatika India Next and Godrej Air, pairs with itself and with Manesar rather than with the older city. IB home tutors in Gurgaon who live on this side can run a full evening inside these sectors; one who lives in Sushant Lok will quote a later start and mean it. IMT Manesar, Hero Honda Chowk, Sector 33, Sector 34 and Sector 37 belong to the same planning block, and a Manesar family is usually better served by a tutor already living along the NH-48 stretch.

The Dwarka Expressway sectors, Sector 102, Sector 103, Sector 104, Sector 106, Sector 108, Sector 109, Sector 110 and Sector 113, with Godrej Summit, Sobha City and ATS Kocoon, form their own island. They pair with each other and with Palam Vihar, not with Sohna Road. Old Gurgaon and Palam Vihar, covering Palam Vihar, Civil Lines, Sadar Bazar, Jacobpura, Rajendra Park, Ashok Vihar, Sector 4, Sector 14, Sector 15, Sector 22 and Sector 23, is the other half of that pairing, and parents searching for IB tuition near me from Sector 14 are often matched westward rather than towards Golf Course Road.

So the practical rule for anyone comparing IB tuitions in Gurgaon is this: ask which corridor the tutor already teaches in on your chosen days. A tutor whose evening already runs through your corridor will keep your slot stable for a year. A tutor crossing the city to reach you will keep it for a month, then start asking to shift it, and the family will blame the student's progress for something that was always a logistics problem.

New Gurgaon pairs with Manesar, rarely with the older city corridors
Dwarka Expressway sectors pair with Palam Vihar, not with Sohna Road
Bhondsi and Ansal Esencia: weekend slots or mostly online lessons

contentBlocks.heading: What four weeks of IB tuition should have changed
contentBlocks.body:
Four weeks of IB tuition in Gurgaon is long enough to judge the working relationship and far too short to judge a grade. What you should see by then is narrower and more useful than a mark: the student can say what they were getting wrong and why, homework arrives with fewer blank spaces, and the tutor can name two or three specific weaknesses rather than saying the child needs to practise more. If none of that has happened, the fit is probably wrong and a different tutor should be shortlisted.

Grades move on the school's clock, not the tutor's. A DP student starting in October will see the difference in mocks, which each school sets on its own dates several months before May. An MYP student's criterion scores may move on one criterion first, often criterion A or the one the tutor chose to attack, while the others hold. That is normal and it is progress. A PYP parent should look for confidence and willingness to attempt a question rather than any score at all.

No tutor can guarantee a grade, and anyone in Gurgaon who offers one is telling you something about themselves rather than about your child. Starting late narrows what is possible; a student who begins serious work in DP2 in January has fewer levers than one who began in DP1. Some students do not need a tutor at all, and a good first conversation occasionally ends with that conclusion.

Ask for a short written note after each session and a proper review every four to six weeks. Two lines on what was covered and what was set is enough for the weekly note. The review is where you decide whether to continue, change frequency, switch a subject or change the tutor. Parents who fix that review date in advance have that conversation calmly; parents who do not tend to have it in the middle of a bad week.
items: Week four: the student can name the mistake, not just repeat the topic
Homework returning with fewer blank spaces is a real early signal
MYP progress often shows on one criterion before the others move
A DP student's first honest measure is the school's own mock papers
Fix a four to six week review date before the first session happens
No tutor can guarantee a grade, and a late start narrows the options

contentBlocks.heading: Your first IB tuition session in Gurgaon: what to have ready
contentBlocks.body:
Have four things on the table before the tutor arrives: the last two pieces of marked work, the school's assessment calendar including mock dates, the subject syllabus or course outline the school issued, and a note of the topics the student says they dread. The first session is diagnostic. A tutor who spends it asking questions and reading the student's own handwriting is doing the right thing, even if it feels slower than a parent expected.

For a home session, decide the room in advance and clear it. A dining table with the television off beats a bedroom desk in most Gurgaon flats, because the parent is nearby without sitting in. Keep a folder that stays in the house, so the tutor is not rebuilding context from a phone gallery each week. For an online session, test the audio and the shared screen once before the lesson rather than during it.

The first session should end with three things said out loud: what the tutor found, what will be worked on next, and what the student should do before the next lesson. If it ends with only warmth and general encouragement, ask for those three directly.

Parents looking for the best IB tuition in Gurgaon often start by comparing names. Start by comparing evenings instead. Work out which slot the household can genuinely hold for a year, then find the verified tutor whose corridor matches it, whether that is an IB DP tutor in Gurgaon for Physics HL or an MYP tutor in Gurgaon for criterion-based Maths. The tutor you can actually keep is worth more than the one who looked best on paper.
items: Bring the last two pieces of marked work to the first session
Have the school's assessment calendar and mock dates written down
Choose the room before the tutor arrives and clear the table
Test audio and shared screen before an online lesson, not during it
End session one with findings, next steps and work for the week
Pick the slot the household can hold, then match the tutor to it

faqs.question: Do you have IB tutors in my sector, or only around Golf Course Road?
faqs.answer: Coverage runs across the whole city, though availability differs by corridor and by subject. Golf Course Road, Golf Course Extension Road, Sohna Road, the DLF phases and Sushant Lok are the densest for home tuition. New Gurgaon, the Dwarka Expressway sectors, Old Gurgaon, Palam Vihar and Manesar are covered too, with fewer tutors per subject, so a specialist subject there may be matched online instead. Tell IB Gram your sector and society when you send the query and you will be told honestly which of the two applies to your case.

faqs.question: Can a home tutor reach Sector 82 or Sector 89 in New Gurgaon on a weekday evening?
faqs.answer: Yes, when the tutor is already teaching on that side of the city, which is the question to ask first. New Gurgaon sectors pair with each other and with Manesar rather than with the older corridors, so a tutor living near Sector 84 or Pataudi Road can run a full evening there without difficulty. A tutor coming from Sushant Lok will quote a later start. If the household needs a half past six slot specifically, a mostly online arrangement with one weekend home session is usually steadier.

faqs.question: How does society gate entry work when a tutor visits every week?
faqs.answer: Register the tutor once as a regular visitor and the weekly friction disappears. In larger societies such as DLF The Crest, Central Park Resorts or Godrej Summit, that means a short visit to the facility office with the tutor's name, phone number and a photograph, after which entry runs on the standard visitor app or gate pass. In builder floors and older colonies like Sector 45 or Jacobpura, a phone call to the guard on the first day is usually enough. Do it before session one, not during it.

faqs.question: Which parts of Gurgaon are genuinely hard to cover with home classes?
faqs.answer: Bhondsi, Ansal Esencia, Gwal Pahari, IMT Manesar and the outer Dwarka Expressway sectors are the honest answer. They are not unreachable, but a weekday evening trip there costs a tutor an entire second session, so fewer tutors offer midweek slots and those who do start later. Families in these areas usually end up with one home session at the weekend and one or two live online lessons during the week. That arrangement holds better through the year than a weekday slot everyone quietly resents.

faqs.question: Should we pick the nearest tutor or the better-matched one further away?
faqs.answer: Take the nearer tutor when the subject is common and the levels match, and the further one when the subject is scarce. A Mathematics AA SL tutor two sectors away will out-perform a distant specialist simply by turning up reliably. A Physics HL or Chemistry HL specialist is worth reaching for, and in that case the sensible arrangement is online rather than asking someone to cross Gurgaon twice a week. The question to ask is not who is closest, but who can hold this slot in December as well as in August.

faqs.question: What happens if a home session is missed because of traffic or a school event?
faqs.answer: Agree the rule before it happens, because it will happen. Most families and tutors settle on one of two arrangements: the session converts to a live online lesson the same evening, or it is rescheduled once within the same week. Both are reasonable. What causes friction is having no rule, so a missed Tuesday quietly becomes a lost Tuesday. Put the cancellation terms in a message before the first session, including how much notice each side gives and what happens if the tutor is unwell.

faqs.question: How many sessions a week does an IB student usually need?
faqs.answer: It depends on stage and how close the exam session is, and honest answers come as ranges rather than numbers. A PYP or early MYP student generally does well with one session a week in one area of difficulty. An MYP 4 or MYP 5 student working towards criterion-based assessments usually needs one or two. A DP student typically runs one or two per subject, rising before the school's mock examinations and easing afterwards. More hours are not automatically better; a student who never works alone stops learning to work alone.

faqs.question: Is IB online tuition in Gurgaon actually worse than a tutor at home?
faqs.answer: It is different, and better for some work than others. Annotated past papers, worked Mathematics, and structured science revision run very well on a shared screen, and online opens tutors your corridor cannot supply. It is weaker for younger students, for anything that needs someone reading a confused expression, and for long discussion work. Most families in the far sectors land on hybrid: one home session to set the direction and mark work, one online for practice and doubt-solving. Judge it after three lessons, not one.

faqs.question: We are shifting from Sohna Road to the Dwarka Expressway side. Can the same tutor continue?
faqs.answer: Possibly, but do not assume it. Sohna Road and the Dwarka Expressway sectors sit on opposite planning blocks, and a tutor whose evening line runs through Nirvana Country or Malibu Towne is unlikely to carry it across to Sector 106 or Sector 110. Two options usually work: continue with the same tutor online so the relationship and the notes carry over, or ask IB Gram for a fresh shortlist on the new side and overlap them for a fortnight. Give notice of the move early rather than after the boxes arrive.

faqs.question: What does the free trial class show, and does it commit us to anything?
faqs.answer: A demo or trial session can be arranged before the family commits, and it exists to answer one question: does this tutor teach this student well? Watch for whether the tutor asks the student to work rather than lecturing, whether they can name a specific weakness by the end, and whether the student speaks more in the second half than the first. It commits you to nothing. If the answer is no, ask for a different profile; that request is ordinary and nobody takes offence.

faqs.question: My child is in MYP 4 and everything is criterion-based. Can a tutor who mainly teaches DP help?
faqs.answer: Sometimes, but check it directly rather than assuming the board name is enough. MYP is marked against four criteria, A to D, each out of 8, and the criterion total out of 32 converts to a 1 to 7 grade through IB grade boundaries. A tutor used only to DP papers may teach the content well and still not know how criterion descriptors are applied. Ask which MYP years they have taught and ask them to mark one piece of your child's work against the criteria during the trial.

comparison.heading: How does IB home tuition in Gurgaon compare with a coaching centre batch?
comparison.intro: A home tutor suits a student who needs attention on their own mistakes and a slot built around school buses and activities. A coaching centre batch suits a disciplined student who works better with others in the room and a fixed syllabus march. A live online group class suits far sectors and scarce subjects. The trade-off that usually decides it is whether the student's problem is effort or understanding.

introSummary: An IB home tutor in Gurgaon is only as useful as the corridor they can reliably reach on a fixed weekday evening, which is why this page is organised by place rather than by teaching method. Home tutoring means someone travelling to the family's own flat, villa or society, from Golf Course Road down to Manesar, and the practical question in every corridor is the same: does traffic, gate entry and the school's own bus timing leave a workable window most weeks, or is online the more honest answer for this particular address. contentBlocks.heading: How IB Gram Fixes a Stable Home Tutoring Slot
contentBlocks.body:
A request for an IB home tutor in Gurgaon starts with two things most agencies ask about last: the corridor the family lives in, and the specific weekday evenings that are actually free once school, buses and activities are accounted for. IB Gram asks this before asking about subject or level, because a brilliant tutor who cannot reliably reach Sector 108 on Dwarka Expressway by six in the evening is not the right match for a family there, whatever their board experience looks like on paper.

Once the corridor and window are fixed, IB Gram checks which tutors are already teaching nearby on that evening. A tutor already working Golf Course Road on Tuesdays can often extend into DLF Phase 5 or Sector 54 on the same run, holding the slot far more reliably than someone starting cold from Old Gurgaon or Manesar. This is the difference between a tutor who arrives on time most weeks and one who cancels the first time traffic on NH-48 turns bad.

The programme, subject and level are matched next, against the same verified profile system used across IB Gram: board experience on this specific syllabus, the exact level taught, and familiarity with the general pacing families at schools in the area tend to expect. A shortlist of two or three profiles follows, each one already checked for corridor fit before the family even sees it, so the comparison that remains is genuinely about teaching quality, not travel guesswork.

Only then does a trial lesson get booked, at the family's home, in the actual slot being considered for the term. If the slot does not hold after the first few weeks, whether because of traffic, a school schedule change, or simple fit, the family can ask for a different match, subject to availability, and the corridor-first approach means the next suggestion starts from a stronger position than the first.

contentBlocks.heading: Which IB Stage Needs Which Kind of Home Tutor?
contentBlocks.body:
The Primary Years Programme runs from roughly ages three to twelve, taught through units of inquiry across six transdisciplinary themes, among them how we express ourselves, how the world works and how we organize ourselves, rather than separate timetabled subjects marked in isolation. There are no external examinations at this stage. A home tutor working with a PYP student is usually supporting the inquiry itself, helping the child research, structure and present ideas, and that final year closes with the PYP exhibition, a student-led project a tutor should support rather than direct.

The Middle Years Programme spans five years, MYP 1 to MYP 5, roughly ages eleven to sixteen, across eight subject groups, with every subject assessed against four criteria, A to D, each scored zero to eight. The criterion total out of thirty-two converts to a final one-to-seven grade through the school's own boundaries, which means a MYP home tutor needs to think in criterion language, not just correct answers. MYP 5 brings the Personal Project, the Community Project usually sits in MYP 3 or 4, and MYP eAssessment, on-screen exams plus ePortfolios, is optional and decided school by school.

The Diploma Programme is two years, DP1 and DP2, six subjects across six groups, three or four at Higher Level with two hundred and forty recommended teaching hours, the rest at Standard Level with one hundred and fifty hours. Grading runs one to seven per subject, with Theory of Knowledge and the Extended Essay adding up to three further points, taking the maximum to forty-five and the diploma minimum to twenty-four, subject to the IB's own failing conditions, alongside Creativity, Activity, Service running the whole two years. Most Gurgaon IB schools sit the May session; a minority use November, mostly for retakes.

An IB DP tutor in Gurgaon working Golf Course Road or Sushant Lok needs, at minimum, to know which level, HL or SL, the student is actually placed on before the first session, since teaching to the wrong depth wastes real time. A MYP tutor in Gurgaon, by contrast, is judged more on how well they teach to criteria than on content breadth alone, and a good shortlist reflects this distinction rather than treating every IB tutor as interchangeable.
items: PYP: ages three to twelve, six transdisciplinary themes, inquiry-based, no external exams.
MYP: MYP 1 to MYP 5, eight subject groups, four criteria scored zero to eight each.
MYP 5 Personal Project, Community Project in MYP 3 or 4, MYP eAssessment optional.
DP: two years, six subjects, HL at 240 recommended hours, SL at 150.
DP grading one to seven per subject, up to 45 maximum with TOK and the Extended Essay.

contentBlocks.heading: How Deep Does an IB Subject Tutor Need to Go?
contentBlocks.body:
A tutor who can immediately name whether a DP Mathematics student is on Analysis and Approaches or Applications and Interpretation, without needing to ask twice, has usually taught the syllabus for real rather than learned the labels recently. These are separate courses with different calculator rules and different exam papers, not two difficulty bands of the same content, and a family that is unsure which their child is actually enrolled in should check with the school before a tutoring plan is built around the wrong one.

In the sciences, Higher Level and Standard Level share a common syllabus core but diverge sharply in depth, and the internal assessment, an individually designed and written-up practical investigation, carries real weight in the final grade. A subject tutor should be comfortable walking a student through how to frame a strong research question for this investigation and how it gets marked, not only through exam-style questions. English A, for students being assessed in their first language, and English B, for language acquisition, test genuinely different skills, and a tutor unclear on which applies wastes valuable early sessions.

Across the Diploma, Theory of Knowledge and the Extended Essay sit outside the six subject groups yet add up to three points between them, and a tutor who has actually supervised a TOK exhibition or an Extended Essay in a relevant subject brings real, specific value here, understanding how claims and counterclaims are weighed and how a research question is assessed, rather than offering only general essay advice.

Command terms run through both MYP and DP and decide how much a correct-seeming answer is actually worth. Define wants a precise, bounded statement. Explain wants a reasoned account with cause and effect made clear. Evaluate and discuss want a weighed judgement across more than one side, not a list of points. An IB home tutor in Gurgaon who drills command terms alongside content, whether in DLF, on Golf Course Extension Road or further out toward New Gurgaon, tends to protect marks that pure content revision alone misses.
items: DP Maths: Analysis and Approaches versus Applications and Interpretation are different courses, not tiers.
Sciences: HL and SL share a syllabus core but diverge in depth and the IA.
English A tests first-language skills; English B tests language acquisition, a real difference.
TOK and the Extended Essay add up to three points beyond the six subjects.

contentBlocks.heading: What Should a Gurgaon Parent Check Before a Home Visit?
contentBlocks.body:
Before any profile is shown to a family, IB Gram checks a tutor's subject background against the specific level and syllabus they claim to teach, and confirms genuine teaching or tutoring experience on this board rather than accepting a general claim of comfort with international curricula. A subject degree alone does not mean someone can teach a MYP criterion or a DP mark scheme well; those are distinct, learnable skills, and IB Gram's shortlist favours tutors who can demonstrate them in conversation, not just list them on a profile.

Before a home visit specifically, it is worth confirming a few practical things directly with the tutor: which corridor and societies they already work in regularly, roughly how they plan to arrive given the evening's traffic, and what identification or contact detail the family should hold on file. Most societies across Gurgaon require visitor registration at the gate, and a tutor familiar with a specific society's process tends to start sessions on time far more reliably than one arriving there for the first time.

A trial lesson remains the real test. Watch whether the tutor asks about the student's actual gaps before launching into content, whether they reference the right paper or criterion by name, and whether the student appears more settled, not more anxious, by the end of the session. A tutor who cannot explain their own approach clearly to a parent beforehand is unlikely to explain a mark scheme clearly to the student either.

No certificate substitutes for this. A workshop certificate or a general teaching qualification shows training, not fit with this specific student in this specific corridor. IB Gram's matching process exists to get a family to a fair trial quickly, with a shortlist narrow enough to judge properly rather than an open list to sort through alone, and the family can always ask for a different match, subject to tutor availability, if the trial does not go well.

contentBlocks.heading: What Does Steady Progress Look Like Across a Gurgaon School Year?
contentBlocks.body:
Progress with a home tutor should be visible within a handful of sessions, not necessarily in marks yet, but in how the student approaches a problem when stuck. A student who previously left a difficult question blank should, within a month, at least attempt a method, and a MYP student should start referencing criteria by letter rather than only asking whether an answer is right. No tutor can guarantee a grade, and any claim that sounds like a guarantee, whatever corridor or provider it comes from, is worth being sceptical of.

Across a full Gurgaon school year, progress naturally dips around mock examinations, coursework deadlines and festival breaks, and a good tutor names these dips honestly rather than either blaming the student or insisting everything is on track when it visibly is not. A plateau during a demanding Extended Essay draft or a hard TOK claim is not usually a sign the tutor or the arrangement is failing; it is often just a genuinely hard stretch of the syllabus that needs more time, not a different tutor.

Traffic and travel also affect consistency in ways families sometimes forget to factor in. A tutor who is reliably on time in Golf Course Road through most of the term but starts arriving late as winter fog or festival traffic worsens is not necessarily a poor match; the corridor itself has changed. Raising this directly, and discussing whether a hybrid week here and there would help, tends to preserve a good tutor relationship better than quietly losing patience with lateness that has an obvious cause.

It is also fair, and sometimes the right call, for a tutor to say a student no longer needs regular tutoring on a subject once independence has built up and school support alone is enough. A tutor who never says this over a full year is worth questioning. The goal across any Gurgaon corridor is a student who needs the tutor less over time, not one who stays dependent indefinitely on sessions that could now be reduced.

faqs.answer: Evening traffic between a tutor's previous session and the family's home can stretch a short trip considerably, particularly on Sohna Road, the Golf Course Extension Road stretch, and the Dwarka Expressway corridor during peak hours. The nearest tutor is convenient, but a family should weigh that against subject depth, particularly for a Higher Level subject or a specific syllabus need like DP Mathematics Analysis and Approaches, where a slightly further specialist with the right experience may serve the student better than the closest generalist. IB Gram's shortlist balances both factors rather than defaulting to proximity alone, and for genuinely specialist needs in lower-density corridors, an online session with the right specialist is often the more honest answer than compromising on subject fit.

faqs.question: What if we switch from CBSE or ICSE mid-course into the IB?
faqs.answer: This is common enough that most experienced IB home tutors across Gurgaon corridors have handled it before, though the adjustment suits some subjects more smoothly than others. The bigger shift is usually assessment style rather than content, since MYP's criterion-based marking and DP's command-term-driven answers reward writing differently than many board exams do. A tutor who has specifically guided students through this switch before is worth prioritising over one who has only ever taught students already inside the IB system.

faqs.question: Does the tutor follow our child's school's own pacing across the term?
faqs.answer: A tutor cannot see a school's internal scheme of work directly, but a good one will ask for recent tests, topic lists or any materials the school shares, and align sessions to run alongside classroom teaching rather than a separate sequence of their own. This matters most around coursework and internal assessment deadlines, where working against the school's actual timeline, not a generic one, keeps a student from being pulled between two different plans in the same week.

faqs.question: What does the free trial or demo class actually cover?
faqs.answer: A trial lesson with a matched tutor opens with a short diagnostic conversation about where the student currently stands, moves into a real piece of content or a past question worked through together at the family's home, and closes with the tutor's early read on what the first few weeks would focus on. It is not a full lesson of new content delivered at speed. The point is honest fit, for both student and tutor, before committing to a term of regular sessions.

faqs.question: How soon can a home tutor start once a corridor and slot are confirmed?
faqs.answer: This depends on tutor availability for the family's specific corridor and evening, so it varies rather than following one fixed timeline. Families in denser corridors like Golf Course Road or DLF typically see faster matching, given the wider pool of tutors already working there, while requests from Manesar, Dwarka Expressway or New Gurgaon may take a little longer simply because fewer tutors run a regular route through those areas.

h1: IB Home Tutors in Gurgaon: How to Compare and Shortlist, Sector by Sector
heroTitle: IB Home Tutors in Gurgaon, Compared Properly
heroSubtitle: Most families shortlist two or three IB home tutors before choosing one. This page walks through what a strong profile should show, how to run trial lessons fairly, what a side-by-side comparison actually looks like, and how IB Gram helps you switch if the first match is not right for your child.
introSummary: IB home tutors in Gurgaon are best chosen in twos and threes, not one at a time: a parent who compares two or three verified profiles side by side, on board experience, level, school familiarity and travel, usually ends up with a far better match than someone who hires the first name that replies. Home tuition is IB Gram's starting point for every family here, because most parents want a tutor sitting at the dining table with their child, in their own sector, on a slot that survives school traffic; online and hybrid remain real options, covered honestly rather than dismissed. This page sets out a working shortlist process, a side-by-side comparison checklist, how to run two trial lessons without unsettling a young learner, and what happens when a match does not click and needs replacing.

contentBlocks.heading: Building a Shortlist of IB Home Tutors in Gurgaon
contentBlocks.body:
A parent who hires the first IB home tutor who answers the phone is gambling with a subject the school will keep testing for the next two years. IB Gram's shortlist approach exists because the difference between two seemingly similar tutors, both calling themselves an IB tutor in Gurgaon, can be significant once you look past the headline claim: one may have taught MYP Science criteria for years, the other may be strong at DP Physics but have never marked against a criterion rubric. Comparing two or three profiles, rather than one, surfaces that gap before a single rupee changes hands.

A useful profile answers four questions plainly: which programme stage the tutor actually teaches (PYP, MYP or DP, since these ask for different skills), which subjects at what level, how familiar the tutor is with the family's specific school's pacing, and whether the sector and slot genuinely work for a home visit. An IB DP tutor in Gurgaon who teaches HL Maths AA should be able to describe, in a sentence, how their teaching changes for a student doing SL instead, or for AI rather than AA. A vague answer here is worth noting.

IB Gram's intake conversation is built to surface this before a shortlist goes out. A parent describes the board stage, subject, current grade or predicted grade if known, and the sector or society where lessons will run. From this, the shortlist is narrowed to tutors whose profiles are verified and genuinely match, rather than a long list of generalists who tutor across boards without depth in any one. A MYP tutor in Gurgaon working with a Personal Project student, for example, is a different specialist from a DP tutor coaching Extended Essay drafts, even though both sit under the same IB umbrella.

Comparing properly means writing down, not just remembering, how each shortlisted tutor answered the same set of questions. Memory blurs after two long phone calls in one evening; a short table on paper or in a notes app does not. IB tutors in Gurgaon vary widely in style, even within the same subject and level, and the comparison stage is where that becomes visible before a family commits to months of sessions.
items: 1. Tell IB Gram the board stage, subject and sector so the search for a home tutor starts narrow.
2. Receive two or three verified profiles matched on level, subject depth and realistic travel time.
3. Read board experience closely, since MYP criteria and DP command terms need specific, practised skills.
4. Book a trial lesson with each shortlisted tutor instead of committing after one phone call.
5. Compare every trial against one fixed checklist, then confirm the home tutor whose fit is clearest.

contentBlocks.heading: Matching a Home Tutor to Your Child's IB Programme Stage
contentBlocks.body:
IB home tutors in Gurgaon rarely teach the same way across every stage, and a parent shortlisting tutors should know which stage their child is actually in before comparing profiles. The Primary Years Programme (PYP), for ages three to twelve, is organised around six transdisciplinary themes, among them how we express ourselves and how the world works, delivered through units of inquiry rather than a fixed subject timetable. A PYP home tutor's job looks less like subject teaching and more like supporting the inquiry the classroom has already set in motion, plus the ten attributes of the IB learner profile that PYP asks every student to practise. There are no external examinations at this stage, so a tutor here is building habits, not chasing a grade.

The Middle Years Programme (MYP) covers five years, MYP 1 through MYP 5, roughly ages eleven to sixteen, across eight subject groups. Every subject is assessed against four criteria, labelled A to D, each scored zero to eight; the criterion total out of thirty-two converts to a final grade of one to seven through the IB's grade boundaries. A MYP tutor in Gurgaon who has never marked against these criteria will tend to teach content the way CBSE or ICSE tutors do, which does not translate well, since MYP rewards structured reasoning against a named criterion far more than raw recall. MYP 5 brings the Personal Project, with the Community Project sitting in MYP 3 or 4 instead, and eAssessment as an optional route each school decides on its own.

The Diploma Programme (DP) is two years, DP1 and DP2, six subjects from six groups, three or four taken at Higher Level (HL) with two hundred and forty recommended teaching hours, and the rest at Standard Level (SL) with one hundred and fifty hours. Each subject is graded one to seven. Theory of Knowledge (TOK) and the Extended Essay (EE) combine for up to three additional points, taking the maximum score to forty-five, with twenty-four the minimum for the diploma itself, subject to the IB's own failing conditions; Creativity, Activity, Service (CAS) has to be completed alongside the six subjects. A home tutor working with a DP1 student needs a genuinely different plan from one working with a DP2 student six months from the May session.
items: PYP runs from age three to twelve, organised around six transdisciplinary themes rather than separate subjects.
MYP spans five years, MYP 1 to MYP 5, roughly ages eleven to sixteen, across eight subject groups.
Every MYP subject is marked against four criteria, A to D, each scored zero to eight.
DP is two years, DP1 and DP2, six subjects from six groups, three or four at Higher Level.
TOK and the Extended Essay add up to three extra points on top of the six subject grades.

contentBlocks.heading: What Does IB Subject Tutoring Actually Cover at Home?
contentBlocks.body:
Subjects named on this page, IB Mathematics AA and AI, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, English A and English B, and TOK and the Extended Essay, each ask a home tutor for a different kind of depth. Mathematics splits into Analysis and Approaches (AA) and Applications and Interpretation (AI), at both Higher Level and Standard Level, and a tutor who only knows one strand well will struggle with a student who needs to compare the two before choosing, or who has already chosen and needs depth in exactly that strand's worked problems rather than a generic maths refresher.

The sciences, Physics, Chemistry and Biology, bring Internal Assessment (IA) into home sessions alongside content: a tutor reviewing a student's IA draft needs to know what a strong research question and data analysis section actually look like under DP criteria, not just whether the underlying physics or chemistry is correct. This is different work from homework help, and it usually needs more session time as DP2 progresses toward the IA deadline.

English A and English B are frequently confused by families new to the IB, and they need different tutors. English A is a literature and language course assessed on analysis and argument; English B is a language acquisition course for students still building fluency in English as an additional language. A tutor strong in one is not automatically strong in the other, and asking directly which the child is enrolled in, before a trial lesson, saves a wasted session.

Theory of Knowledge and the Extended Essay sit outside the six subject groups but carry real weight, up to three additional points combined. A TOK tutor helps a student build and defend a knowledge question rather than summarising content; an EE tutor questions a student's research question and structure without drafting sentences for them, since Extended Essay supervision has firm rules about how much help is appropriate. Families searching for an IB DP tutor in Gurgaon for TOK or the EE specifically should expect this coaching style, not conventional subject teaching.
items: IB Mathematics splits into Analysis and Approaches (AA) and Applications and Interpretation (AI), each at HL or SL.
IB Physics, Chemistry and Biology combine content teaching with internal assessment guidance and practical work review.
IB English A and English B need different tutoring: literary analysis against criteria versus language acquisition.
Theory of Knowledge tutoring focuses on structuring an argument, not content recall or memorised facts.
The Extended Essay needs a supervisor-style tutor who questions a research question without writing it for the student.

contentBlocks.heading: School Calendars and Pressure Points for Gurgaon Families
contentBlocks.body:
Families whose children attend international schools in Gurugram (Gurgaon), Haryana, among them Pathways World School, Aravali, Pathways School Gurgaon, Lancers International School, Scottish High International School, GD Goenka World School, Heritage Xperiential Learning School, The Shri Ram School, Aravali and DPS International Edge, deal with a calendar built around continuous assessment rather than one big exam at the end of the year. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named here, the International Baccalaureate, Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel; these names are included only as local context for the pressures families here navigate.

Most Gurgaon IB schools enter students for the May exam session, with November used by a minority of schools and by retake candidates. Each school sets its own DP2 mock examination dates, usually several months ahead of May, and these mocks tend to be the first real pressure point a home tutor should plan around, since they reveal gaps early enough to act on them. Coursework deadlines run on a separate clock: CAS reflections, the Personal Project in MYP 5, Internal Assessments across DP subjects and Extended Essay drafts all have their own dates, set by the school, that do not move for a tutor's convenience.

Past papers, mark schemes and subject reports reach a family through the school or the IB's own official channels, and these are what actually show how marks get awarded, more reliably than a tutor's general impression of difficulty. Command terms, define, describe, explain, evaluate, discuss, to what extent, set how much depth an answer needs, and a good home tutor drills a student on reading the command term correctly before writing anything, since a well-written answer to the wrong depth still loses marks.

Winter break, Diwali and other festival holidays fall in the run-up to several of these pressure points most years, compressing revision time right when a family least expects it. A tutor who has worked with Gurgaon international school families before tends to build this into a term plan rather than treating every week as identical, front-loading harder content earlier in the term so the final weeks before a mock or the May session are used for practice and review rather than new material.

Coordinators publish assessment calendars each term; families should check these directly with the school.
CAS, the Personal Project and internal assessments each carry deadlines separate from exam dates.

A tutor familiar with a school's general pacing can plan sessions around known pressure points.

contentBlocks.heading: Home Tuition, Online or Hybrid: What Actually Suits Your Shortlist?
contentBlocks.body:
Home tuition is where most families searching for IB home tutors in Gurgaon start, and for good reason: a tutor sitting beside a student at their own desk, with the student's actual textbook, notes and past homework in front of them, tends to work best for younger learners, for subjects that need a lot of worked examples on paper, and for students who focus better without a screen between them and the tutor. A home tutor also sees a student's study space, which a screen call never shows, and can suggest small changes that make revision easier between sessions.

Online lessons earn their place for a different reason: subject scarcity. A DP student doing an unusual HL combination, or needing a specialist for TOK or the Extended Essay specifically, may not find a strong match within a reasonable drive, and an online specialist beats a mediocre nearby generalist most of the time; a family specifically searching for an IB online tutor in Gurgaon for this reason is making a reasonable, specific choice, not settling for less. Shared whiteboards and annotated past papers work well on screen for subjects built around worked problems, though a tutor and student both need reasonably reliable internet and a quiet room for this to hold together over a full session.

Hybrid arrangements, a standing home session each week with an occasional online catch-up before a mock or when the family is travelling, give most Gurgaon households the best of both without asking either side to commit fully to one format. A parent shortlisting IB home tutors in Gurgaon should ask directly, at the trial stage, whether a given tutor is genuinely comfortable in both formats or only really strong in one, since a tutor who is excellent at the kitchen table but stiff on a screen is not automatically a good hybrid choice.

None of this is free of trade-offs. Home visits cost travel time that online does not, and evening traffic on corridors like Sohna Road or the Southern Peripheral Road can turn a short trip into a long one; online removes that but loses the easy read of body language and handwriting that a home tutor gets for free. The honest answer for most families is to start with home tuition, keep online in reserve for weeks it is genuinely needed, and treat hybrid as the fallback rather than the default.
items: Home tuition suits younger students and subjects needing worked examples on paper in real time.

contentBlocks.heading: How IB Gram Verifies a Home Tutor Before the First Gurgaon Visit
contentBlocks.body:
IB Gram checks a tutor's profile for board experience, subject depth and the level they actually teach, PYP, MYP or DP, before it goes into any shortlist a parent sees. This filtering happens before a family ever hears a name, which is the point: a parent comparing two or three IB home tutors in Gurgaon should be comparing already-verified profiles against each other, not vetting strangers from scratch on their own.

Verification on paper only goes so far, though, and a family should treat it as the first filter, not the final one. The genuinely useful check happens at the trial lesson: does the tutor actually mark work the way they described on a call, do they explain a wrong answer clearly rather than just supplying the right one, and does the student's face relax or tighten over the course of the hour. A tutor can describe MYP criteria fluently in a phone conversation and still teach differently in the room; the trial is where that gap shows up.

A parent can reasonably ask a shortlisted tutor to talk through how they marked a past student's assignment, using it as a concrete example rather than an abstract claim about experience. A tutor who resists this, or who can only speak in generalities about 'years of experience' without a specific example, is worth a second look before committing to a full term.

Before the first home visit, IB Gram confirms the tutor's identity, the agreed sector and society, and the exact slot, so a parent is not opening the door to someone unexpected or dealing with a last-minute address confusion. A parent choosing to stay in the next room, or at the dining table itself, for a first session is entirely reasonable, especially with a younger student or a new tutor; most tutors expect this and are not thrown by it. What matters more than where the parent sits is whether the first session gives a clear, honest read on fit, since that read is what the shortlist comparison ultimately comes down to.

Parents should ask to see how a tutor marks a past assignment, not just hear about it.

contentBlocks.heading: Comparing IB Home Tutors: A Side-by-Side Checklist
contentBlocks.body:
A side-by-side comparison only works if every shortlisted tutor is judged against the same fixed set of questions, asked in the same order, ideally written down rather than carried in memory after a long day of calls. Five checkpoints cover most of what actually predicts a good match: whether the tutor teaches this exact programme stage and level, not just the IB in general; whether they have worked with this specific school's pacing before, or at least a genuinely similar one; how the trial lesson actually goes, judged by whether the student can repeat back what was covered afterward, not by how confident the tutor sounded beforehand; whether the sector, society and slot hold up realistically on an ordinary weekday, not just on the day of the trial when everyone made a special effort; and how the tutor talks about progress, in specific, checkable terms rather than general reassurance.

Running two or three trial lessons in the same week, rather than spreading them across a month, keeps the comparison fair, since a student's mood, tiredness and homework load shift week to week and can otherwise skew an impression that has nothing to do with the tutor. It helps to tell a younger student, gently, that these are 'meeting a few teachers' sessions rather than framing any one of them as the final tutor, which keeps the process from feeling unsettling if the family ultimately chooses someone else.

If the first tutor chosen from a shortlist does not work out after a fair trial period, four to six weeks is usually enough to tell, asking IB Gram for a different match is a normal part of the process, not an awkward complaint. A family that raises a concrete concern, uneven sessions, a mismatch with the school's pacing, a student who has stopped engaging, tends to get a faster, better-matched replacement than one that waits and hopes it improves on its own. Comparing properly at the start reduces how often this becomes necessary, but it does not eliminate the need for it entirely, and that is a normal, expected part of finding an IB home tutor in Gurgaon who genuinely fits.
items: Board and level match: does the tutor teach this exact stage, not just this board generally.
School familiarity: has the tutor worked with this school's pacing or only a different one.
Trial lesson clarity: could the student repeat back what was taught at the end of the hour.
Travel and slot: does the sector and timing genuinely hold up on a normal weekday.
Communication style: does the tutor explain progress in specific terms rather than vague reassurance.

contentBlocks.heading: How Long Should It Take Before You See Real Progress?
contentBlocks.body:
Progress with an IB home tutor rarely looks like a straight line, and a parent expecting one risks giving up on a tutor who is actually working. In the first two or three sessions, what a family should reasonably expect is a clear read on fit, does the student engage, does the tutor's explanation style land, not yet a measurable change in marks. That read matters because it is the point at which switching costs almost nothing; waiting two months to notice a mismatch costs real time against a fixed exam calendar.

Confidence tends to show before scores do. A student who was quiet about a subject and starts bringing up specific questions unprompted, or attempting homework before a session rather than only during it, is showing a real early signal, even if the next class test result has not moved yet. No tutor can guarantee a grade, and any claim that sounds like one is worth treating with real suspicion; what a good tutor can offer is steady, checkable progress against specific gaps, not a promised outcome.

Plateaus happen, often right before a mock, when a student is consolidating rather than visibly advancing, and this is not automatically a sign the tutoring has stopped working. What separates a normal plateau from a genuine problem is specificity: a tutor who can name which topic improved, which recurring mistake has stopped showing up in homework, and what is being worked on next is giving a family something to evaluate. A tutor who only offers general reassurance, 'doing well,' 'making progress,' without ever naming a specific improvement, is harder to trust over a full term, and it is fair to ask directly for the specifics behind the general comment.
items: A clear, specific read on fit should be possible within the first two or three sessions.
Visible confidence in class often arrives before a visible change in test scores.
No tutor can guarantee a grade; steady, checkable progress is the honest measure instead.
A plateau after weeks of good sessions is common before a mock and is not automatic failure.
Ask for specifics, which topic improved, which mistake stopped recurring, not just general reassurance.

contentBlocks.heading: Getting Started With IB Home Tutors in Gurgaon
contentBlocks.body:
Starting is simple: a parent sends a query or books a free consultation, and IB Gram asks about board, syllabus, level, school calendar, location and schedule before anything else happens. Having the board stage, PYP, MYP or DP, the subject or subjects, the child's current level and the sector or society ready in advance makes this first conversation faster and the resulting shortlist noticeably better matched.

It helps to mention any specific pressure point already on the calendar, an upcoming mock, an IA deadline, an Extended Essay draft due in a few weeks, since this shapes how a tutor plans the first month of sessions. A family that only says 'we need an IB tutor' gets a broader shortlist than one that says 'we need a DP1 HL Physics tutor before the November mock', and the second version is easier to match well and faster to act on.

The shortlist itself, once received, is where the comparison process described on this page begins: two or three verified profiles, a trial lesson with each, a fixed checklist, and a decision. A demo or trial session can be arranged before the family commits to anything longer, and lessons can run at home, online or in a hybrid mix depending on what the shortlist conversation surfaces as the right fit. If, a few weeks in, the fit is not right, asking for a different tutor is a normal request, not an inconvenience, and it is worth deciding in advance, as a family, what a fair trial period looks like so that decision does not get delayed by hope alone.

Subject to tutor availability, and depending on level and schedule, most families can expect a shortlist within a short window of that first conversation, with a home visit, an online session or a hybrid start arranged once a tutor from the shortlist is confirmed. Parents search for this in different ways: 'IB home tutors near me', 'best IB home tutors in Gurgaon', 'IB home tutors Gurugram', or by corridor, 'IB home tutors Golf Course Road', 'IB home tutors Golf Course Extension Road', 'IB home tutors Sohna Road', and all of them lead to the same shortlist-and-compare process described on this page.

faqs.question: How many IB home tutors should I compare before choosing one?
faqs.answer: Two or three is usually enough. Comparing a single tutor in isolation gives you no baseline, since you have nothing to measure their trial lesson against; comparing more than three tends to blur into decision fatigue without adding much useful information. IB Gram typically sends two or three verified profiles matched on board stage, level and sector, and a short trial lesson with each is enough to see real differences in teaching style, clarity and how the student responds, well before a full term of fees is committed.

faqs.question: What should I actually compare between two IB home tutors?
faqs.answer: Compare board and level fit first: does the tutor teach this exact programme stage, PYP, MYP or DP, at this level, not just the IB broadly. Then compare school familiarity, whether they have worked with a similar pacing before; how the trial lesson goes, judged by whether the student can repeat back what was taught; whether the sector, society and slot genuinely hold up on an ordinary weekday; and how specifically the tutor talks about progress afterward. Writing these down during or right after each trial keeps the comparison fair rather than relying on memory a day later.

faqs.question: Can I run trial lessons with more than one home tutor without confusing my child?
faqs.answer: Yes, and framing it well matters more than the number of trials itself. Tell a younger student these are simply a few sessions to see who explains things most clearly, rather than presenting any single trial as the final choice, and most children take this in stride. Running two or three trials in the same week, rather than spreading them across a month, also keeps the comparison fair, since a student's mood and tiredness shift week to week in ways that have nothing to do with a tutor's actual ability.

faqs.question: What if the first IB home tutor we chose is not working out?
faqs.answer: Ask IB Gram for a different match; this is a normal, expected part of the process, not an awkward complaint. Four to six weeks is usually enough to fairly judge a match, and raising a specific concern, uneven sessions, a mismatch with the school's pacing, a student who has stopped engaging, tends to get a faster, better-matched replacement than waiting and hoping the fit improves on its own. Comparing carefully at the start reduces how often this happens, but it does not remove the need for it entirely.

faqs.question: Does a home tutor really work better than a coaching centre for IB?
faqs.answer: It depends on what a student needs right now. A home tutor gives full attention and a pace that adapts to one student alone, which matters for a subject where gaps are specific and individual, such as an IA draft or a particular HL topic a student keeps missing. A coaching centre batch costs less per hour and adds peer discussion, which suits a student who is broadly on track and benefits from hearing classmates' questions. Neither is universally better; the honest answer depends on how individual the current gap is.

faqs.question: Does IB home tuition work for a student in DLF Phase 5 or Sushant Lok?
faqs.answer: Yes, both corridors are well covered for home visits on an ordinary weekday evening. DLF Phase 5 sits on the Golf Course Road corridor, close to DLF Phase 1 and Sectors 42 to 54, and Sushant Lok sits centrally near South City 1 and the Millennium City Centre area, both corridors a tutor can usually reach without the longer traffic stretches seen further out on Sohna Road or the Southern Peripheral Road. The specific slot still depends on the individual tutor's own weekly route and availability.

faqs.question: Will a home tutor travel to Sector 82 or the Dwarka Expressway on a weekday evening?
faqs.answer: Often yes, though these newer corridors have a thinner pool of nearby tutors than areas like Golf Course Road, so availability can take a little longer to confirm. New Gurgaon, covering Sectors 82 to 90, and the Dwarka Expressway, covering Sectors 102 to 113, are both growing corridors where online or hybrid sessions sometimes fill a gap week while a matching home tutor is confirmed. Mentioning the exact sector and society upfront speeds this up considerably.

faqs.question: What happens if a scheduled home session is missed?
faqs.answer: Tell the tutor and IB Gram as early as possible so the slot can be rearranged rather than simply dropped for the week. A missed home session is generally easier to convert into a short online catch-up than to reschedule twice in a week already tight with school activities and homework. Repeated last-minute cancellations from either side are worth raising directly, since a stable weekly rhythm matters more to steady progress than any single session does on its own.

faqs.question: How does IB home tuition fit around school buses and evening activities?
faqs.answer: Most families fix a slot after accounting for the school bus arrival time, any regular sport or activity, dinner and homework, leaving a realistic one-and-a-half to two-hour window most weekday evenings. A home tutor working the same sector regularly tends to already know the general rhythm of school timings in that corridor, which makes fixing a stable weekly slot faster than starting from scratch each time. Weekend sessions are also common, particularly for a subject needing longer, less interrupted blocks such as an IA or EE working session.

faqs.question: Is online tutoring a genuine alternative to a home tutor for IB?
faqs.answer: For some subjects and situations, yes. Online suits a specialist subject, such as an unusual HL combination or TOK, where no strong nearby home tutor exists, and it removes the travel time that a home visit needs. It suits a home visit less well for younger students or subjects that lean heavily on worked examples on paper in real time. Most families end up treating online as a genuine option for a share of sessions rather than an either-or choice against home tuition.

faqs.question: Is there a cost to comparing tutors before choosing one?
faqs.answer: No. Comparing shortlisted profiles and running a trial lesson with more than one tutor before choosing does not add cost beyond what a single trial would cost; this comparison stage exists precisely so a family is not committing to a full term before seeing a real lesson. Tuition itself is priced per session or in packages, subject to tutor availability and depending on level and schedule, but that pricing structure is the same whether a family compares two tutors or hires the first one they speak to.

contentBlocks.heading: How IB Gram Matches a Home Tutor to Your Corridor in Gurgaon
contentBlocks.body:
When a query comes in for IB home tuition in Gurgaon, sometimes typed as IB home tuition Gurugram, IB Gram starts with logistics before it starts with subject. A family searching ib home tuition near me is usually asking exactly this: which sector or society do you live in, and which weekday evenings are realistically free once school, buses and activities are accounted for? A family on Golf Course Road with a DP2 student two months from mocks has a different urgency than a PYP parent in New Gurgaon asking about a single weekly session. Both get the same starting questions, answered on their own terms, whether the search that brought them here was for IB home tuition, IB tuitions in Gurgaon, or something else entirely.

Next comes the academic profile: board, programme stage, subject or subjects, and whether the need is Higher Level (HL) depth, Standard Level (SL) consolidation, or MYP criterion-based skills. A tutor who has only taught DP Physics HL is the wrong match for a MYP student working on criterion-based investigations, even if both sit under the IB umbrella. IB Gram asks about the school's own scheme of work too, since two IB schools in the same corridor can pace a syllabus differently.

Only then does the shortlist get built, drawn from tutors whose profiles are verified and who already travel the family's corridor, or who teach online with a setup suited to the subject. A free consultation or trial session follows before anything is committed, subject to tutor availability. If the fit is wrong after that first month, the family can ask for a different match rather than persisting with someone who is not working.

This is not always instant. A specialist for a scarce combination, DP Economics HL paired with a Tuesday evening slot in Sushant Lok, for example, can take longer to place than a general MYP tutor for Sector 57. IB Gram would rather take an extra day and get the subject, level and travel right than rush a placement that has to be undone in three weeks.

contentBlocks.heading: PYP, MYP or DP: Where Does Your Child Sit in the IB?
contentBlocks.body:
Gurgaon's IB schools place students in one of three programmes by age. The Primary Years Programme (PYP) runs from ages 3 to 12 and has no external examinations. The Middle Years Programme (MYP) covers five years, roughly ages 11 to 16. The Diploma Programme (DP) is the two-year course, usually the final two years of school, that ends in externally graded exams.

PYP learning is organised around six transdisciplinary themes: Who we are; Where we are in place and time; How we express ourselves; How the world works; How we organize ourselves; Sharing the planet. Units of inquiry run through the year, built around the ten attributes of the IB learner profile, and the final year closes with the PYP exhibition. IB home tuition at this stage in Gurgaon is less about content drilling and more about inquiry skills, reading stamina and the confidence to present in front of a class.

MYP runs across eight subject groups over five years, MYP 1 to MYP 5. Every subject is marked against four criteria, A to D, each scored out of 8; the criterion total out of 32 converts to a final grade of 1 to 7 through IB grade boundaries. MYP 5 brings the Personal Project, with the Community Project sitting in MYP 3 or 4, and some schools also offer optional MYP eAssessment, on-screen examinations combined with ePortfolios. A MYP tutor in Gurgaon needs to teach to those criteria specifically, not to a generic syllabus.

DP is six subjects from six groups over two years, DP1 and DP2, three or four at Higher Level (HL, 240 recommended teaching hours) and the rest at Standard Level (SL, 150 hours). Each subject is graded 1 to 7, and Theory of Knowledge (TOK) and the Extended Essay (EE) together add up to 3 more points, for a maximum of 45 and a minimum of 24 to be awarded the diploma, subject to the IB's own failing conditions. Creativity, Activity, Service (CAS) runs alongside. An IB DP tutor in Gurgaon needs to know exactly which of these six subjects, and at which level, a family is asking about.
items: PYP: ages 3 to 12, six transdisciplinary themes, units of inquiry, no external examinations.
MYP: five years, eight subject groups, four criteria per subject scored out of 8 each.
DP: two years, six subjects, three or four at Higher Level and the rest at Standard Level.
DP grading: 1 to 7 per subject, up to 3 more from TOK and the EE, 45 maximum.
MYP 5 brings the Personal Project; the Community Project sits in MYP 3 or 4.

contentBlocks.heading: What Does IB Home Tuition Cover Subject by Subject?
contentBlocks.body:
IB home tuition in Gurgaon most often covers Mathematics, the sciences, English, and the two components that run across the whole DP, Theory of Knowledge (TOK) and the Extended Essay (EE). Each has its own structure, and a tutor strong in one is not automatically the right match for another, even within the same subject group.

DP Mathematics is offered as Analysis and Approaches (AA) and Applications and Interpretation (AI), each available at Higher Level (HL) or Standard Level (SL). The two share a name but not a syllabus, so a family asking for a Maths home tutor in Gurgaon should say which one their child is actually sitting, and at which level, before a tutor is shortlisted.

Physics, Chemistry and Biology at DP level include an internally assessed component alongside the examined papers, marked by the school against the IB's own criteria; a home tutor can help with the underlying concept and how the write-up is structured, but the work itself has to be the student's own. At MYP level, the same three sciences are marked against the programme's own criteria rather than a DP-style assessment.

English A, language and literature, or literature, and English B, as an additional language, sit in different subject groups and are marked differently, so a tutor needs to know which one applies before planning a lesson. Theory of Knowledge and the Extended Essay run across every DP subject rather than belonging to one, and both carry deadlines the school sets well before the May exam session that most Gurgaon IB schools use. Command terms such as define, describe, explain, evaluate and discuss set how much depth an answer needs, at MYP and DP level alike, and past papers and markschemes circulated through the school or the IB's own channels show how marks are awarded for each one.

contentBlocks.heading: The Gurgaon School-Year Calendar Behind Every Home Tuition Slot
contentBlocks.body:
Families across Gurgaon whose children attend international schools, among them Pathways World School Aravali, Pathways School Gurgaon, Lancers International School, Scottish High International School, GD Goenka World School, Heritage Xperiential Learning School, The Shri Ram School Aravali and DPS International Edge, face a school calendar that shapes when IB home tuition can realistically happen. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named here, the International Baccalaureate, Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel.

Most Gurgaon IB schools enter DP students for the May exam session; a minority use the November session, along with students retaking a subject. Each school sets its own DP2 mock examination dates, usually several months before May, and those mocks are the point at which a family's sense of urgency changes fastest. Results from the May session are released in early July, which is also when many families start planning IB tuition in Gurgaon for the year ahead.

Term structure around Diwali, winter and summer breaks, unit tests, and the run-up to mocks all compress the weeks when a regular home slot is easiest to hold. A tutor working with a DP2 student in the two months before mocks is doing revision and past-paper work under real time pressure; the same tutor working with the same student earlier in the year has room to build understanding more slowly. Past papers, markschemes and subject reports circulated through the school or the IB's own channels remain the clearest guide to how marks are actually awarded, and a good tutor uses them rather than guessing at standard.

School buses, after-school activities and evening traffic on the corridor a family lives in all narrow the realistic slot further. A student who gets home later after a bus route through Sohna Road has a different evening than one who walks home in Sushant Lok, and IB Gram asks about this directly before proposing a weekly time.

contentBlocks.heading: Home, Online or Hybrid: What Actually Works for IB in Gurgaon?
contentBlocks.body:
For most families across Gurgaon, IB home tuition, a verified tutor teaching at your own home, works best because it removes travel for the student on an already long school day and gives a tutor a direct look at the notes, folders and habits behind the marks. Online and hybrid lessons are real alternatives, not consolation prizes, and each suits specific situations better than home tuition does.

Home tuition suits younger PYP and MYP students who concentrate better in a familiar room, and DP students in the final stretch before mocks who need a tutor physically present to check working line by line. It depends on a stable weekday evening slot and a corridor a tutor can reach without an unreasonable commute, which is why corridors such as New Gurgaon and Dwarka Expressway, further from the main tutor pool, see more families choosing online by default.

IB online tuition in Gurgaon removes the travel question entirely and opens up specialist tutors, a DP Economics HL tutor, say, who might not otherwise serve your corridor. Shared digital whiteboards and annotated past papers work well for problem-based subjects like Mathematics and the sciences; TOK discussion also transfers online reasonably well. What online struggles with is a distracted younger student, or the kind of quiet observation a tutor makes watching how a student actually writes an essay under time pressure.

Hybrid, most sessions at home with an occasional online session when travel or a schedule clash makes a physical visit impractical, is what many Gurgaon families settle into after a term or two. It keeps the relationship consistent while giving flexibility for a week when the tutor cannot reach Sohna Road in evening traffic, or when a family is travelling. None of the three is objectively best; the honest answer depends on the student's age, the subject, and the corridor.

Online tuition: opens up specialist and examiner-trained tutors who may not serve your corridor.
Hybrid: mostly home, with online sessions when travel or scheduling makes a visit impractical.
Distant corridors such as New Gurgaon and Dwarka Expressway often lean online by default.
No format guarantees a grade; the right choice depends on age, subject and corridor.

contentBlocks.heading: How IB Gram Verifies a Tutor Before They Enter Your Home
contentBlocks.body:
IB Gram checks a tutor's subject background, the boards and levels they have actually taught, and references before a profile is shortlisted for a home visit. None of this replaces a parent's own judgement in the first session, and IB Gram tells families that directly rather than asking them to simply trust a badge. Families searching best ib home tuition in Gurgaon are often looking for exactly this: a way to judge fit, not a ranking, since no independent platform can make an unverifiable claim about being better than every other option.

What IB Gram verifies: IB home tutors in Gurgaon are checked on academic background and subject match to what a family is asking for, teaching experience at the specific programme and level, PYP, MYP or DP, and HL or SL where relevant, and references from previous families where available. A free consultation or trial session can be arranged before a family commits to anything ongoing, and IB Gram asks about board, syllabus, level, school calendar, location and schedule before proposing a match.

What a parent should check themselves: ask to see how the tutor marks a past paper or a piece of work against the actual IB criteria, not just whether the answer is right. Ask what happens in the first session, whether it is diagnostic or straight into content. For a home tutor specifically, confirm identification at the door for the first visit, and agree with the tutor and IB Gram what happens if a session needs to be rescheduled.

Verification is ongoing rather than a one-time check. If a match is not working, the pace is wrong, the personality does not fit, or a MYP tutor turns out to be more comfortable with DP content, a family can ask IB Gram for a different tutor rather than persisting. No tutor, however experienced, can guarantee a grade, and any claim that one can should be treated as a warning sign rather than reassurance.
