contentBlocks.heading: Which IB or IGCSE Programme Should Your Tutor Specialise In?
contentBlocks.body:
An IB and IGCSE tutor worth hiring in Gurgaon specialises in one structure deeply rather than claiming all four loosely: the IB Middle Years Programme (MYP), the IB Diploma Programme (DP), Cambridge IGCSE (Cambridge International Education), or Pearson Edexcel International GCSE.

A DP tutor needs to understand a two-year course, DP1 and DP2, of six subjects from six groups, three or four at Higher Level (HL, 240 recommended teaching hours) and the rest at Standard Level (SL, 150 hours), each graded 1 to 7, with Theory of Knowledge (TOK) and the Extended Essay (EE) worth up to 3 more points between them, a maximum of 45 and a minimum of 24 for the diploma itself, subject to the IB's own failing conditions, alongside Creativity, Activity, Service (CAS). Most Gurgaon IB schools enter students for the May session, results in early July, with November used by a minority of schools and by retake candidates, and a DP tutor should know which session their student is actually sitting.

An MYP tutor works across five years, MYP 1 to 5, roughly ages 11 to 16, over eight subject groups, each assessed against four criteria, A to D, scored 0 to 8, with the criterion total out of 32 converting to a final 1 to 7 grade through IB grade boundaries; the Personal Project sits in MYP 5, the Community Project earlier in MYP 3 or 4, and MYP eAssessment in MYP 5, on-screen exams plus ePortfolios, is optional and left to each school.

An IGCSE tutor, whether teaching to Cambridge or Pearson Edexcel International GCSE, works within a two-year course across Grades 9 and 10, usually a step before the IB DP, A Levels, or CBSE or ISC in Class 11. Cambridge sits February/March (offered only in India), May/June and October/November series, grading most syllabuses A* to G with some 9-1 versions under different codes; Edexcel sits January and May/June, grading 9 to 1 throughout, and many Cambridge subjects split into Core (capped at grade C) and Extended (reaching A*) tiers, a distinction a good IGCSE to IB DP transition tutor tracks closely as a student moves up.
items: A DP tutor works six subjects, three or four HL, graded 1-7, 45 points maximum.
An MYP tutor works eight subject groups, criteria A-D, converted to a 1-7 grade.
A Cambridge IGCSE tutor should know the Core and Extended tier split.
A Pearson Edexcel International GCSE tutor works a 9 to 1 scale throughout.
An international board tutor in Gurugram should name their programme specialism upfront.

contentBlocks.heading: How Deep Should Your IGCSE or DP Tutor's Subject Knowledge Go?
contentBlocks.body:
Deep enough to mark a past paper the way an examiner would, not just deep enough to explain the topic in general terms; that is the real test of an IGCSE or DP tutor's subject knowledge.

A DP tutor should teach directly to command terms, define, describe, explain, evaluate, discuss, to what extent, since these set how much depth an answer needs, and should work from real past papers, mark schemes and subject reports, sourced through the school or the IB's own official channels, showing a student exactly how marks are awarded rather than just what the right answer is. For Internal Assessment (IA), the Extended Essay (EE) or Theory of Knowledge (TOK), a tutor needs fluency in the assessment criteria themselves, since generic writing advice does not translate into marks against a specific rubric.

An IGCSE tutor needs to know whether a student is on the Core or Extended tier for a given Cambridge subject, since Core tops out at grade C and Extended reaches A*, and should be honest early if a tier change looks right rather than waiting until it is too late in the two-year course to matter. A tutor teaching Pearson Edexcel International GCSE, graded 9 to 1 without the same Core and Extended split on most subjects, needs a correspondingly different sense of what each grade actually requires.

Ask any tutor you are considering to walk through a recent past paper question live, on the spot, rather than describing their approach in the abstract; how they actually work through marks lost and marks gained tells you more in five minutes than a CV does in five paragraphs.
items: A strong tutor teaches directly to command terms and marks like an examiner would.
Past papers and mark schemes should come from the school or the IB's own channels.
IA, EE and TOK need assessment-criteria fluency, not generic writing advice.
A tutor should flag a Core-to-Extended tier change honestly and early.
Ask a prospective tutor to work through a real past paper question live.

contentBlocks.heading: Finding an IB and IGCSE Tutor Corridor by Corridor in Gurgaon
contentBlocks.body:
Manesar and the NH-48 corridor, around IMT Manesar, Hero Honda Chowk and Sectors 33, 34 and 37, is where an online-first search usually turns up more genuine subject specialists than a home-only search, since fewer tutors keep a standing weekday evening route this far south given traffic on NH-48. Old Gurgaon and Palam Vihar, covering Civil Lines, Sadar Bazar, Jacobpura, Rajendra Park, Ashok Vihar and Sectors 4, 14, 15, 22 and 23, has an established tutor presence for weekday evenings, though a tutor unfamiliar with the narrower lanes near Sadar Bazar or Jacobpura may need more travel time than a map suggests.

Dwarka Expressway, Sector 102 through Sector 113, with societies including Godrej Summit, Sobha City and ATS Kocoon, and New Gurgaon, covering Sectors 82 to 90, Kherki Daula and Pataudi Road, with societies such as Vatika India Next and Godrej Air, are both newer corridors where a tutor's weekend availability tends to be wider than their weekday evening availability, since fewer tutors have built a standing route out to either yet. Southern Peripheral Road (SPR), through Sectors 66 to 72, Ansal Esencia and Bhondsi, with Tata Primanti among its societies, sits in a similar position, closer to New Gurgaon in practice than to the older parts of the city.

Sushant Lok 1 and 2, South City 1, and the Millennium City Centre area, Sectors 29, 40, 45 and 46 and Greenwood City, sit centrally enough that a tutor's own commute is rarely the limiting factor, evening traffic aside. DLF Phases 2 to 4, MG Road and Cyber City, Sikanderpur, Chakkarpur and Sectors 24, 27 and 28, with societies such as DLF Beverly Park, Heritage City, DLF Hamilton Court, DLF Regency Park, DLF Richmond Park and Ambience Caitriona, sit near the metro line, which a good number of tutors use for part of their own commute rather than driving the whole way.

Sohna Road, Sector 47 through Sector 50, Nirvana Country, South City 2, Rosewood City, Uppal Southend, Vatika Chowk and Badshahpur, with societies like Central Park Resorts, Orchid Petals, Vatika City, Malibu Towne, Vipul Greens and The Close, has one of the largest resident tutor pools in the city, which generally means a wider choice of specialists per subject. Golf Course Extension Road, Sector 56 to Sector 65, Sushant Lok 3, Ghata and Gwal Pahari, with societies such as M3M Golf Estate, Ireo Grand Arch and Ireo Skyon, and Golf Course Road, DLF Phase 5, DLF Phase 1, Sectors 42, 43, 53 and 54, Ardee City and Wazirabad, with societies including DLF The Magnolias, DLF The Aralias, DLF Park Place, DLF The Crest and DLF The Belaire, round out the corridors with the deepest tutor availability in the city, gate entry and visitor registration at the larger societies considered.

contentBlocks.heading: What School Timetables Across Gurgaon Mean for Your Tutor's Schedule
contentBlocks.body:
A tutor's schedule ultimately answers to your child's school calendar, and families near Gurgaon's international schools, among them Pathways World School Aravali, Pathways School Gurgaon, Lancers International School, Scottish High International School, GD Goenka World School, Heritage Xperiential Learning School, The Shri Ram School Aravali and DPS International Edge, each work to that particular school's own term dates and test schedule. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named here, the International Baccalaureate, Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel.

Most Gurgaon IB schools enter students for the May exam session, with DP2 mock examinations usually set several months earlier, on dates each school fixes independently, and a good tutor adjusts their pace as that date approaches rather than teaching at a flat rate all year. A minority of schools sit the November session, and retake candidates need a tutor able to plan backward from a different exam date than the rest of their peer group.

For IGCSE, a tutor needs to know whether their student's school follows Cambridge, sitting February/March (offered only in India), May/June and October/November, or Pearson Edexcel International GCSE, sitting January and May/June, since unit tests, mocks and coursework deadlines land differently depending on which. Because several schools in the same corridor can run mock weeks in the same fortnight, a tutor's own diary fills up fast in the weeks before exams, which is another reason asking a prospective tutor about their current student load, not just their qualifications, is a fair question to raise before committing.

contentBlocks.heading: Should Your Tutor Teach at Home or Online in Your Part of Gurgaon?
contentBlocks.body:
Home classes, a verified tutor teaching in your own sitting room, are IB Gram's lead arrangement across Gurgaon, and most families ask for this first: it keeps the student in a familiar setting, lets the tutor see actual textbooks and notes, and lets a parent be present if they want to be. Golf Course Road, Golf Course Extension Road, Sohna Road, DLF 2 to 4 and Sushant Lok are corridors where a tutor teaching at home on weekday evenings is generally realistic.

For a family in Manesar, deep New Gurgaon, or along Dwarka Expressway, an online-first search widens the field considerably, since a specialist DP Higher Level tutor who would never commit to that drive on a weekday can still teach the same student over a shared screen. Online teaching does less well for a student who needs someone physically present to stay focused, or for work where a tutor genuinely needs to watch a student's hand on paper in real time.

Most families settle into hybrid within a term or two: home classes most weeks, an online session swapped in for a heavy traffic week, an exam period, or when the usual tutor is travelling. To put it plainly, home suits a student who concentrates better with an adult in the room and a corridor where the commute is realistic; online suits specialist subjects, harder-to-reach corridors, and families who value flexibility; hybrid suits most families once the first few weeks show which sessions genuinely need to be face to face.

This is not a decision made once and locked in. A family starting with home classes on Sohna Road can move a session online during a particularly bad traffic week, and a family starting online in Manesar can add a Saturday home session once the arrangement settles.

contentBlocks.heading: Vetting an IB or IGCSE Tutor Before They Visit for Home Classes
contentBlocks.body:
IB Gram verifies a tutor's profile against the exact board, level and subject before shortlisting them, and confirms their genuine availability for your corridor and slot, and none of this replaces a parent's own judgement at the trial class stage.

Ask a shortlisted tutor directly about their specific experience with your child's board and level, whether Cambridge IGCSE, Pearson Edexcel International GCSE, MYP or DP, and ask how they would approach the first lesson. Use the trial to judge teaching style, pace and how the tutor responds when your child gets something wrong, since this matters more day to day than the credentials on a profile.

For home classes specifically, confirm with your society's front desk what visitor registration involves ahead of the first session, since some of the larger Golf Course Road and Golf Course Extension Road societies ask for ID at the gate and a call up to the flat, adding a few minutes a tutor needs to plan for. Ask whether the tutor has taught in your society before, since familiarity with gate procedure, parking and lift access genuinely affects whether a 6pm slot starts on time.

If, after the trial or a few weeks in, the match is not right, say so plainly. IB Gram can offer a different tutor rather than have a family persist with a mismatch, whether the arrangement is home classes, online lessons, or a hybrid of the two.

Keep a short note after each trial, what the tutor covered, how your child reacted, and any question they could not answer clearly, so a decision a week later is based on something more solid than a fading first impression.

contentBlocks.heading: How One Tutor's Weekly Route Covers Several Gurgaon Corridors
contentBlocks.body:
A tutor working across Gurgaon does not treat the city as one place; they build a weekly route out of corridors close enough together that the drive between two lessons does not swallow the gap you have booked. A tutor anchored on Golf Course Road commonly extends into Golf Course Extension Road on the same evening; one anchored around DLF 2 to 4 or MG Road often extends into Sushant Lok and South City 1, since Cyber City sits between them. A Sohna Road tutor's route tends to stay within Sohna Road's own neighbouring sectors rather than crossing toward Golf Course Road on the same evening, and a tutor working SPR or New Gurgaon typically keeps those two together rather than adding an older corridor to the same night. Dwarka Expressway, Old Gurgaon and Manesar each usually need a tutor whose route is already anchored nearby, or an online arrangement instead, since they rarely sit inside another corridor's natural loop.

Locking in a slot that survives the whole term, rather than shifting week to week, comes down to a few steps.
1. Pick a weekday evening or weekend slot that survives your child's activities and school bus timing for at least the next couple of months, not just the coming week.
2. Give IB Gram your exact corridor and society so travel time and gate procedure are weighed when a tutor is shortlisted.
3. Use the trial class to confirm the slot actually works in practice, arriving on time with enough runway before homework or dinner.
4. Agree with the tutor upfront what happens if a session is missed, made up later in the week or simply dropped.
5. Revisit the slot after mocks or a major school test, since workload shifts and a slot that worked in August may not suit January.

A family on Sohna Road choosing between two open evenings has real room to manoeuvre; a family in Manesar or deep New Gurgaon with one workable evening should hold it firmly, since a cancelled slot there is far harder to fill again the same week.

contentBlocks.heading: How to Judge Whether a Home Tutor Is Actually Working
contentBlocks.body:
Choosing an IB and IGCSE tutor in Gurgaon is only the first half of the job; judging whether that tutor is actually working matters just as much. Judge a tutor by small, checkable signs before you judge them by a report card: is the student answering to the right command term rather than just the right topic, is working shown clearly enough for method marks, are careless errors on timed past papers actually going down over a few weeks. Ask to see marked past papers and the tutor's own notes on where marks were lost, which tells you more than a general sense that lessons feel productive.

No tutor can guarantee a grade, and treat any suggestion otherwise with real caution. A tutor who starts close to a mock or the exam session itself is working within a narrower window than one who starts months earlier, since command-term technique and exam strategy take weeks of practice to become habit, not a single session. A good tutor also sharpens a student's own effort rather than replacing it; if a tutor is doing more of the thinking than the student in a session, something in the arrangement needs to change.

It is also fair to say not every gap needs a standing weekly tutor. A student behind on one specific topic may need three or four focused sessions rather than an arrangement that runs for the rest of the year, and IB Gram would rather point this out than keep a family paying for more than they need. Review progress every four to six weeks against the school's own tests and mock results, since the school's own markers are ultimately the ones whose judgement counts.

contentBlocks.body:
Send a query or book a free consultation, and be ready with your child's board (Cambridge IGCSE, Pearson Edexcel International GCSE, MYP or DP), subject, grade and roughly which sector or society you live in, since this is what lets IB Gram shortlist a tutor who can genuinely reach you or match you well online.

The first session, trial or otherwise, usually starts with the tutor understanding where your child currently stands: recent test or mock results if you want to share them, which topics feel shaky, and how your child prefers to work. Have the school's own textbooks, recent notes and, where relevant, past papers or mark schemes ready, since a tutor working from the same material as the school reaches useful teaching faster than one starting from a generic worksheet.

For home classes, clear a quiet desk or table with room for two and good lighting for an hour or more, and let your society's gate know to expect a visitor if required. For online lessons, a stable connection and a shared document or whiteboard tool, usually set up by the tutor, are the only real requirements.

From there, lessons continue at home, online or hybrid, on the slot you fixed together, and if the first few sessions show the fit is not right, you can ask for a different tutor. Nothing here commits a family beyond that trial, and availability, particularly for less common subjects or Higher Level, is never guaranteed in advance.

faqs.question: Does the same tutor cover every part of Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: No single tutor covers the whole city, since a workable weekly route only stretches across a few neighbouring corridors before travel time eats into the lesson itself. A tutor anchored on Golf Course Road might extend into Golf Course Extension Road on the same evening, but is unlikely to also reach Manesar or Dwarka Expressway that same week. IB Gram shortlists tutors whose actual route, not just their general willingness, covers your specific corridor, or offers an online match where a nearby route does not exist yet.

faqs.question: How do I find a tutor who already teaches in my society on Golf Course Road?
faqs.answer: Tell IB Gram your exact society when you send a query, since familiarity with a specific building's gate process and visitor registration genuinely affects whether a tutor starts on time. Societies such as DLF The Magnolias or DLF The Crest, and others across Golf Course Road, often already have a tutor or two who regularly teach nearby, and IB Gram will check this before shortlisting rather than offering a tutor who has never worked in your building before.

faqs.question: What is the real difference between an IB tutor and an IGCSE tutor?
faqs.answer: The structures they teach to are genuinely different, even when the underlying subject knowledge overlaps. An IB DP tutor works with six subjects graded 1 to 7, Higher and Standard Level, plus Theory of Knowledge and the Extended Essay, while an IGCSE tutor works within a two-year Grade 9 to 10 course graded either A* to G or 9 to 1, often with Core and Extended tiers on Cambridge subjects. A tutor who has taught one for years is not automatically strong in the other, which is why IB Gram asks which structure before shortlisting anyone.

faqs.question: How much does an IB or IGCSE tutor cost in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: IB Gram does not quote fixed prices here, since cost depends on level, subject, whether lessons are at home or online, and a tutor's own availability. Tuition is generally arranged as a session rate or a package, discussed directly once a tutor is shortlisted, and everything stays subject to availability rather than a fixed listed figure. Send a query or book a free consultation for an accurate answer based on your child's actual board, level and corridor rather than a number that may not apply to your situation.

faqs.question: Is an online tutor really a good option for a family in New Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: Often, yes, particularly for a specialist subject or Higher Level, since fewer tutors currently hold a standing weekday evening route into New Gurgaon's newer sectors. A shared whiteboard and annotated past papers work well on screen for most subjects, and an online tutor opens up options a purely home-based search in this corridor would miss. Families who want a home element too often settle into a hybrid arrangement, home classes on weekends and an online session during the week.

faqs.question: What happens if a tutor misses or has to reschedule a home class?
faqs.answer: Agree this with your tutor before the first session, since IB Gram does not set one fixed rule for every match. Most families agree that a session cancelled with reasonable notice, illness, a school event or unexpected traffic, is made up later that week or the next, while a same-day cancellation without notice is more often simply lost. Ask your shortlisted tutor directly what they usually do, and put it in writing if that helps both sides remember.

faqs.question: Do I need to be home during my child's home tuition session?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily, and it depends on your child's age and the subject. Younger students, and early sessions with a new tutor, often do better with a parent reachable somewhere in the house even if not sitting in the room, while older DP or Grade 10 students usually focus better with just the tutor and student present. Discuss this directly with your shortlisted tutor before the first session, since some tutors have a clear preference and agreeing upfront avoids any awkwardness later.

faqs.question: My child's IB or IGCSE tutor isn't a good fit. Can we switch?
faqs.answer: Yes, and you should say so rather than persisting out of politeness. A mismatch is usually clear within the trial class or the first few real sessions, whether it comes down to teaching style, pace or simply personality, and IB Gram can offer a different tutor once you explain what was not working. This applies equally to home classes, online lessons or a hybrid arrangement, and switching does not mean restarting the whole matching process, since your preferences are already on file.

faqs.question: Is it hard to find an IB DP Higher Level tutor near Sohna Road?
faqs.answer: Generally not, since Sohna Road has one of the largest resident tutor pools in the city, which tends to mean more specialists per subject and level, including DP Higher Level. Societies like Central Park Resorts, Orchid Petals and Malibu Towne, among others along the corridor, regularly see tutors travelling within the area on weekday evenings. A family further out on Sohna Road, near Badshahpur, should still confirm travel time directly with a shortlisted tutor rather than assume the whole corridor behaves the same way.

faqs.question: How soon can a tutor start after we send a query?
faqs.answer: This depends on the board, subject, level and your corridor, and IB Gram would rather give you an honest timeline than a promise it cannot keep. A common subject at a common level in a well-covered corridor like Sohna Road or Golf Course Road can often be matched within days; a less common subject, a Higher Level slot, or a corridor like Manesar or Dwarka Expressway may take a little longer to find the right fit. Booking ahead of a busy period, like the weeks before mocks, generally speeds things up.

faqs.question: Does a tutor travelling to Old Gurgaon or Palam Vihar cost more?
faqs.answer: IB Gram does not quote amounts here, so this is not something to answer with a figure, but it is fair to ask a shortlisted tutor directly whether their availability or terms differ for your specific street or society, since narrower lanes near Sadar Bazar or Jacobpura can add to a tutor's travel time compared with a more direct route elsewhere in the corridor. Raising this early, before the trial class, avoids any confusion once weekly lessons are underway.

faqs.question: Can one tutor teach my child through both IGCSE and into the IB DP?
faqs.answer: Some tutors do this well, but many families end up using a different tutor for each stage, since IGCSE tuition centres on Core versus Extended tier decisions and building technique, while DP tuition works from command terms, Higher Level depth and assessment criteria for the IA, EE and TOK. If continuity across the transition matters to you, say so when you send a query, and ask a prospective tutor directly about their experience with the specific move from Grade 10 into DP1.

contentBlocks.heading: How Does IB Gram Match a Tuition Request to a Tutor in Gurgaon?
contentBlocks.body:

1. You send a query or book a free consultation, telling IB Gram the board (Cambridge IGCSE, Pearson Edexcel International GCSE, MYP or DP), the subject or subjects, the grade, and roughly which corridor you live in, from Golf Course Road to Manesar.

contentBlocks.heading: IB and IGCSE Tuition Across MYP, DP, Cambridge and Edexcel
contentBlocks.body:
IB and IGCSE tuition in Gurgaon usually means one of four structures: the IB Middle Years Programme (MYP) for younger students, the IB Diploma Programme (DP) for the last two years of school, Cambridge IGCSE (Cambridge International Education), or Pearson Edexcel International GCSE, and a tutor who is genuinely fluent in one is not automatically fluent in another.

The DP is a two-year course, DP1 and DP2, of six subjects from six groups, three or four at Higher Level (HL, 240 recommended teaching hours) and the rest at Standard Level (SL, 150 hours), each graded 1 to 7. Theory of Knowledge (TOK) and the Extended Essay (EE) add up to 3 more points between them, so the maximum is 45, with 24 points the minimum for the diploma itself, subject to the IB's own failing conditions, and Creativity, Activity, Service (CAS) has to be completed alongside all of this. Most Gurgaon IB schools enter students for the May exam session, with November used by a minority of schools and by retake candidates, and May results come out in early July. The MYP runs across five years, MYP 1 to 5, roughly ages 11 to 16, over eight subject groups, and every subject is marked against four criteria, A to D, each scored 0 to 8, with the criterion total out of 32 converting to a final 1 to 7 grade through the IB's own grade boundaries. The Personal Project sits in MYP 5 (the Community Project comes earlier, in MYP 3 or 4), and MYP eAssessment in MYP 5, on-screen exams plus ePortfolios, is optional and left to each school to offer or not.

IGCSE tuition here means either Cambridge IGCSE or Pearson Edexcel International GCSE, almost always a two-year course across Grades 9 and 10, and usually a step before the IB DP, A Levels, or a move to CBSE or ISC in Class 11. Cambridge runs exam series in February/March (a series only offered in India), May/June and October/November, grading most syllabuses A* to G, though some now have 9-1 versions under different codes; Pearson Edexcel International GCSE sits January and May/June series and grades 9 to 1 throughout. Many Cambridge subjects split into Core and Extended tiers, Core capped at grade C, Extended reaching A*, and tuition that does not address tier choice early is doing only half the job.

This is why IB Gram asks which programme before anything else. A good IB and IGCSE tutor in Gurgaon, or any international board tutor in Gurugram more broadly, has spent real time inside one specific structure; a tutor who has taught DP Higher Level Physics for years may never have taught Cambridge IGCSE Core Mathematics, and the reverse is just as true. Families managing the move from Grade 10 into DP1 often look specifically for an IGCSE to IB DP transition tutor, someone who has taken students through that exact jump before, since the shift in marking and workload catches many families by surprise.

contentBlocks.heading: What Does a Term of IB and IGCSE Tuition Cover, Subject by Subject?
contentBlocks.body:
A term of IB and IGCSE tuition covers new content pegged to the school's own pace, structured practice against real past papers and mark schemes, and revision timed to mocks and the exam session itself, and what this looks like differs by subject and level far more than most tuition marketing admits.

At DP level, tuition has to work from command terms, define, describe, explain, evaluate, discuss, to what extent, because each one sets how much depth an answer needs, and a student who writes a describe-length answer to an evaluate question loses marks regardless of subject knowledge. Past papers, mark schemes and subject reports, sourced through the school or the IB's own official channels, show exactly how marks are awarded, and tuition that skips this and only reteaches content is not preparing a student for the actual exam. Internal Assessment (IA) and the Extended Essay (EE) research and drafting, and Theory of Knowledge (TOK) essays and the exhibition, all need a tutor who understands the assessment criteria, not just the subject content, and this is a different skill from teaching a syllabus topic.

At IGCSE level, the Core and Extended tier decision on many Cambridge subjects shapes tuition from the start of Grade 9, since Core tops out at grade C and Extended reaches A*, and a tutor moving a student between tiers mid-year needs to know exactly what content and command words each tier actually examines. Pearson Edexcel International GCSE, graded 9 to 1 throughout without a Core and Extended split on most subjects, asks a different kind of preparation, and a tutor fluent in Cambridge's tiering is not automatically fluent in Edexcel's structure.

IB Gram asks which subject and which tier or level before shortlisting, because a tutor's subject depth, not just their general teaching skill, decides whether IB and IGCSE tuition actually moves a student's marks.

contentBlocks.heading: School Calendars That Shape IB and IGCSE Tuition Timing in Gurgaon
contentBlocks.body:
Families across Gurgaon's international schools, among them Pathways World School Aravali, Pathways School Gurgaon, Lancers International School, Scottish High International School, GD Goenka World School, Heritage Xperiential Learning School, The Shri Ram School Aravali and DPS International Edge, deal with broadly similar calendar pressures even though each school sets its own term dates, tests and mock schedules. Most Gurgaon IB schools enter students for the May exam session, so the school year builds toward that: DP2 mock examinations are usually set several months before May, on dates each school fixes independently, and tuition that has not stepped up practice and past-paper work by the time mocks land is starting too late. A minority of schools use the November session instead, and retake candidates from either session need a tutor who can work backward from a different exam date than the rest of their year group.

IGCSE families deal with a different rhythm: Cambridge runs a February/March series available only in India, plus May/June and October/November, while Pearson Edexcel International GCSE sits January and May/June, and a school's choice of exam board and series changes when unit tests, mocks and coursework deadlines fall in Grade 9 and 10. None of this is uniform across corridors either. A family near a school along Golf Course Road may have their mock week clash with the same fortnight a Sohna Road school runs its own pre-boards, both drawing on the same small pool of specialist tutors, which is one more reason booking a stable weekly slot early in the term matters more than most families expect.

contentBlocks.heading: Home Tuition, Online or Hybrid: Which Fits Your Corridor in Gurgaon?
contentBlocks.body:
Home tuition, a verified tutor teaching in your own sitting room or study, is IB Gram's lead service on this page, and for most Gurgaon corridors it is the default families ask for first: the student stays in a familiar setting, the tutor can see the actual textbooks and school notes on the desk, and a parent can be home during the lesson if that matters to them. Golf Course Road, Sohna Road, DLF 2 to 4, Sushant Lok and South City 1 are corridors where home tuition on weekday evenings is generally practical, gate entry and traffic considered.

IB and IGCSE online tuition in Gurgaon trades that physical presence for reach: a family in Manesar or deep in New Gurgaon can access a specialist DP Higher Level tutor who would never keep an evening free for that drive, and a shared whiteboard with annotated past papers covers most subjects perfectly well on screen. What online tuition does less well is the kind of subject where a tutor needs to watch a student's working in real time on paper, or where a younger student simply concentrates better with someone physically in the room.

Hybrid tuition, most weeks at home with an occasional online session swapped in around a school event, a tutor's own travel day, or exam-season traffic, is what many families settle into after the first term. Put simply: home tuition suits students who need an adult physically present to stay focused and corridors where a tutor's travel is realistic on the evenings you need; online tuition suits specialist subjects, awkward corridors like Manesar or SPR on a weekday, and families who value flexibility over presence; hybrid suits almost everyone else, once the first few weeks show which sessions actually need to be in person.

None of this is fixed once chosen. A family that starts with home tuition on Golf Course Extension Road can move a Tuesday session online during a heavy traffic month, or a family starting online in New Gurgaon can add a Saturday home session once term settles, and IB Gram treats this as a normal adjustment, not a failed arrangement.

A tutor who is excellent for a quiet, methodical DP2 Higher Level Maths student may not suit a Grade 9 student who needs more encouragement and shorter bursts of focus.

For home tuition specifically, it is worth confirming with your society's front desk what visitor registration involves before the first session, since some Golf Course Road and Golf Course Extension Road societies ask for ID at the gate and a call up to the flat, which can add a few minutes a tutor needs to plan around. Ask whether the tutor has taught in your corridor before, since familiarity with a society's gate process, parking and lift access genuinely affects whether a 6pm slot starts on time.

If a match is not working after the trial or even a few weeks in, say so. IB Gram can offer a different tutor rather than have a family persist with a mismatch out of politeness, and this applies equally whether the arrangement is home tuition, online, or hybrid.

contentBlocks.heading: Fixing a Stable Weekly Slot for IB and IGCSE Tuition at Home
contentBlocks.body:
A tutor's week has a fixed number of evenings, and the corridors that pair well in one route are the ones close enough together that traffic between them does not eat the gap between two lessons. Golf Course Road and Golf Course Extension Road commonly sit in one tutor's route, as do DLF Phases 2 to 4 with Sushant Lok and South City 1, since MG Road and Cyber City are a short hop from both. Sohna Road tends to pair with its own neighbouring sectors, Nirvana Country through to Badshahpur, rather than crossing to Golf Course Road on the same evening. SPR and New Gurgaon often pair with each other rather than with the older corridors, and Dwarka Expressway, Old Gurgaon and Manesar each tend to need a tutor whose route is already anchored nearby, or an online match instead.

Fixing a slot that actually holds through the term, rather than shifting week to week, comes down to a few steps.
1. Pick a weekday evening or weekend slot that survives your child's activities and school bus timing for at least the next two months, not just this week.
2. Tell IB Gram your corridor and society clearly enough that travel time and gate procedure are factored into who gets shortlisted.
3. Use the trial class to confirm the slot works in practice, not just on paper, arriving on time and leaving enough runway before homework or dinner.
4. Agree with the tutor in advance what happens when a session is missed, whether it is made up later in the week or dropped that week.
5. Revisit the slot after mocks or a major school test, since workload changes and a slot fixed in August may need to move by January.

This matters more in some corridors than others. A family on Sohna Road choosing between two available evenings has real flexibility; a family in Manesar or deep New Gurgaon choosing their one workable evening should expect to hold it firmly, since a cancelled slot there is harder to reschedule the same week given how few tutors already travel that far.

contentBlocks.heading: What Progress From IB and IGCSE Tuition Looks Like, and Its Limits
contentBlocks.body:
What counts as the best IB and IGCSE tuition in Gurgaon usually comes down to fit and consistency rather than any ranking, and progress from IB and IGCSE tuition in Gurgaon usually shows first in smaller, checkable things before it shows in a report card: a student answering to the right command term instead of just the right topic, working shown clearly enough for method marks, fewer careless errors on past papers attempted under timed conditions. A parent can ask to see marked past papers and the tutor's own notes on where marks were lost, which is a more honest signal than a general sense that lessons are going well.

No tutor can guarantee a grade, and any claim that one can should be treated with real suspicion. Tuition that starts close to a mock or the exam session itself narrows what is realistically achievable, since command-term technique and exam strategy take weeks to become habit, not days, and a student who has not engaged with the subject in class has limits a tutor working one or two hours a week cannot fully close. Tuition also works better alongside a student's own effort than instead of it; a tutor who is doing more thinking than the student in a session is not actually teaching.

It is also fair to say tuition is not always the answer. A student who is behind because of a specific misunderstanding in one topic may need three or four focused sessions, not a standing weekly arrangement for the rest of the year, and IB Gram would rather say this plainly than sign a family up for more than they need. Review progress roughly every four to six weeks against the school's own tests and mock results, not against the tutor's own account of the sessions, since the school's markers are the ones whose judgement ultimately counts.

contentBlocks.heading: Starting IB and IGCSE Tuition in Gurgaon: What to Prepare First
contentBlocks.body:
Starting is simple: send a query or book a free consultation, and be ready to say which board (Cambridge IGCSE, Pearson Edexcel International GCSE, MYP or DP), which subject or subjects, which grade, and roughly which sector or society you are in, since this is what lets IB Gram shortlist tutors who can genuinely reach you or match you well online.

The first session, whether a trial class or the first real lesson, usually starts with the tutor understanding where the student currently stands: recent test or mock results if you want to share them, which topics feel shaky, and how the student prefers to work. Have the school's own textbooks, recent notes and, where relevant, past papers or mark schemes on hand, since a tutor working from the same material the school uses gets to useful teaching faster than one starting from a generic worksheet.

For home tuition, clear a quiet desk or table with room for two people and good lighting for an hour or more, and let your society's gate know to expect a visitor if that is required. For online tuition, a stable connection and a shared document or whiteboard tool, which the tutor will usually set up, are the only real requirements.

From there, lessons run at home, online or hybrid, on the slot you fixed together, and if the first few sessions show the fit is not quite right, you can ask for a different tutor. Nothing here commits a family beyond that trial, and availability, particularly for less common subjects or Higher Level, is never guaranteed in advance.

faqs.question: Does IB and IGCSE tuition work the same way in every part of Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: No, it does not, because travel time and tutor availability differ sharply by corridor. Golf Course Road, Golf Course Extension Road and Sohna Road have the deepest pool of tutors already working there, so home tuition on a weekday evening is usually easy to arrange. Corridors like Manesar, SPR and Dwarka Expressway have fewer tutors holding a standing evening route that far, so online tuition or a hybrid week is often the more reliable choice, and IB Gram will say so honestly at the shortlisting stage rather than promising a slot that does not exist.

faqs.question: Can a tutor reach my society on Golf Course Road on a weekday evening?
faqs.answer: In most cases yes, since Golf Course Road, covering DLF Phase 5, DLF Phase 1 and the nearby sectors, is one of the corridors with the deepest existing tutor pool. Gate entry and visitor registration at larger societies like DLF The Magnolias or DLF The Crest can add ten or fifteen minutes, so tutors already familiar with that society's process tend to start lessons on time more reliably. It is worth asking your shortlisted tutor whether they have taught in your specific society before, and confirming visitor registration with your front desk ahead of the first session.

faqs.question: How does IGCSE Grades 9-10 feed into the IB Diploma Programme?
faqs.answer: IGCSE, whether Cambridge or Pearson Edexcel International GCSE, is usually a two-year course across Grades 9 and 10 that many Gurgaon students take before moving into the IB DP, A Levels, or CBSE or ISC in Class 11. The jump changes both marking and workload: IGCSE grades most subjects A* to G or 9 to 1, while the DP grades each subject 1 to 7 across six subjects, three or four at Higher Level, with Theory of Knowledge and the Extended Essay adding up to 3 more points on top. Many families use a different tutor for each stage, since IGCSE and DP specialism rarely overlap fully in one person.

faqs.question: What does IB and IGCSE tuition actually cost in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: IB Gram does not quote fixed prices here, since cost depends on level, subject, whether lessons run at home or online, and tutor availability. Tuition is generally arranged as a session rate or a package, discussed directly once a tutor is shortlisted, and everything stays subject to availability rather than a fixed listed rate. The best way to get an accurate figure for your child's exact board, level and corridor is to send a query or book a free consultation, where IB Gram can talk through the options honestly rather than quote a number that may not apply to your situation.

faqs.question: Is online IB and IGCSE tuition actually as effective as a tutor coming home?
faqs.answer: It depends on the subject and the student, not a blanket answer either way. A shared whiteboard and annotated past papers work well on screen for most subjects, and online tuition genuinely opens up specialist DP Higher Level or less common IGCSE subject tutors that a family in Manesar or New Gurgaon might not otherwise reach on a weekday evening. What online does less well is watching a younger student's working in real time on paper, or keeping a student who is easily distracted properly focused, and for those cases home tuition or a hybrid arrangement tends to work better.

faqs.question: What happens if a home tuition session has to be missed?
faqs.answer: Agree this with your tutor in advance, since practice varies and IB Gram does not set one fixed rule across every match. Most families agree that a session cancelled with reasonable notice, because of a school event, illness or unexpected traffic, is made up later that week or the following one, while a same-day cancellation without notice may simply be lost that week. Ask your shortlisted tutor directly what their own policy is before the first session, and put it in writing if that helps, so both sides know what to expect.

faqs.question: Should a parent be present during a home tuition session?
faqs.answer: There is no single right answer, and it depends on your child's age and the subject. Younger students, and especially early sessions with a new tutor, often benefit from a parent being reachable in the house even if not sitting in the room, while older DP or Grade 10 students usually work better with the tutor and student alone so the session does not feel supervised. Discuss this directly with your shortlisted tutor before the first session, since some tutors have a clear preference and it is easier to agree upfront than to renegotiate later.

faqs.question: Which is better for a family in New Gurgaon or Dwarka Expressway, home or online tuition?
faqs.answer: Online tuition, or a hybrid arrangement with occasional home sessions, is usually the more reliable default for these corridors, simply because fewer tutors already hold a standing evening route that far from the city centre. New Gurgaon, covering Sectors 82 to 90, and Dwarka Expressway, from Sector 102 to Sector 113, are newer corridors where weekend home sessions tend to work better than weekday evenings, given traffic. A family set on weekday home tuition here should expect to book earlier and hold the slot firmly, since a cancelled evening is harder to reschedule the same week.

faqs.question: My child's tutor is not working out. What do we do?
faqs.answer: Tell IB Gram directly rather than persisting out of politeness or waiting out the term. A mismatch is usually clear within the trial class or the first few real sessions, whether it is teaching style, pace, or simply personality, and IB Gram can offer a different tutor once you explain what was not working, so the next match can be adjusted accordingly. This applies equally to home, online and hybrid tuition, and switching does not mean starting the whole matching process from scratch, since IB Gram already has your board, level and preferences on file.

faqs.question: How many sessions a week does IB and IGCSE tuition usually need?
faqs.answer: This depends on the subject, the grade and how close the student is to a mock or the exam session, and IB Gram would rather discuss your child's specific situation than give one number that fits everyone. A student maintaining steady progress in one subject may need a single weekly session, while a student catching up before DP2 mocks, or preparing across two or three IGCSE subjects at once, often needs more. Frequency is something to revisit with your tutor every few weeks rather than fix once at the start and never reconsider.

faqs.question: Does tuition help with revision before school mocks?
faqs.answer: Yes, and this is one of the more common reasons Gurgaon families book IB and IGCSE tuition in the months before mocks. Since most Gurgaon IB schools enter students for the May session and set their own DP2 mock dates several months earlier, tuition in that window typically shifts toward structured past-paper practice, timed conditions, and command-term technique (define, describe, explain, evaluate, discuss, to what extent) rather than new content. IGCSE students preparing for Cambridge's February/March, May/June or Edexcel's January or May/June series follow a similar shift, working from past papers and mark schemes sourced through the school or official channels.

faqs.question: Can one tutor teach both IGCSE and IB DP subjects, or does a family need two?
faqs.answer: Some tutors genuinely teach across both stages well, but many families end up with a different tutor for IGCSE and for the DP, because the two demand different things: IGCSE tuition centres on Core versus Extended tier decisions and building foundational technique, while DP tuition works from command terms, Higher Level depth, and assessment criteria for the IA, EE and TOK. When you send a query, tell IB Gram if you want continuity across both stages, and a tutor's actual experience with the specific transition, not just a claim of covering both, is what should decide the match.

Golf Course Road, Golf Course Extension Road and Sohna Road have the deepest pool of tutors already working there, so home tuition on a weekday evening is usually easy to arrange. Gate entry and visitor registration at larger societies like DLF The Magnolias or DLF The Crest can add ten or fifteen minutes, so tutors already familiar with that society's process tend to start lessons on time more reliably. mainEntity.name: How does IGCSE Grades 9-10 feed into the IB Diploma Programme?

acceptedAnswer.text: IGCSE, whether Cambridge or Pearson Edexcel International GCSE, is usually a two-year course across Grades 9 and 10 that many Gurgaon students take before moving into the IB DP, A Levels, or CBSE or ISC in Class 11. The jump changes both marking and workload: IGCSE grades most subjects A* to G or 9 to 1, while the DP grades each subject 1 to 7 across six subjects, three or four at Higher Level, with Theory of Knowledge and the Extended Essay adding up to 3 more points on top. Many families use a different tutor for each stage, since IGCSE and DP specialism rarely overlap fully in one person.

mainEntity.name: What does IB and IGCSE tuition actually cost in Gurgaon?

acceptedAnswer.text: IB Gram does not quote fixed prices here, since cost depends on level, subject, whether lessons run at home or online, and tutor availability. mainEntity.name: Is online IB and IGCSE tuition actually as effective as a tutor coming home?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the subject and the student, not a blanket answer either way. A shared whiteboard and annotated past papers work well on screen for most subjects, and online tuition genuinely opens up specialist DP Higher Level or less common IGCSE subject tutors that a family in Manesar or New Gurgaon might not otherwise reach on a weekday evening. What online does less well is watching a younger student's working in real time on paper, or keeping a student who is easily distracted properly focused, and for those cases home tuition or a hybrid arrangement tends to work better.

mainEntity.name: What happens if a home tuition session has to be missed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Agree this with your tutor in advance, since practice varies and IB Gram does not set one fixed rule across every match. Most families agree that a session cancelled with reasonable notice, because of a school event, illness or unexpected traffic, is made up later that week or the following one, while a same-day cancellation without notice may simply be lost that week. Ask your shortlisted tutor directly what their own policy is before the first session, and put it in writing if that helps, so both sides know what to expect.

mainEntity.name: Should a parent be present during a home tuition session?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no single right answer, and it depends on your child's age and the subject. Younger students, and especially early sessions with a new tutor, often benefit from a parent being reachable in the house even if not sitting in the room, while older DP or Grade 10 students usually work better with the tutor and student alone so the session does not feel supervised. Discuss this directly with your shortlisted tutor before the first session, since some tutors have a clear preference and it is easier to agree upfront than to renegotiate later.

acceptedAnswer.text: Online tuition, or a hybrid arrangement with occasional home sessions, is usually the more reliable default for these corridors, simply because fewer tutors already hold a standing evening route that far from the city centre. acceptedAnswer.text: Tell IB Gram directly rather than persisting out of politeness or waiting out the term. A mismatch is usually clear within the trial class or the first few real sessions, whether it is teaching style, pace, or simply personality, and IB Gram can offer a different tutor once you explain what was not working, so the next match can be adjusted accordingly. acceptedAnswer.text: This depends on the subject, the grade and how close the student is to a mock or the exam session, and IB Gram would rather discuss your child's specific situation than give one number that fits everyone. A student maintaining steady progress in one subject may need a single weekly session, while a student catching up before DP2 mocks, or preparing across two or three IGCSE subjects at once, often needs more. mainEntity.name: Does tuition help with revision before school mocks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and this is one of the more common reasons Gurgaon families book IB and IGCSE tuition in the months before mocks. Since most Gurgaon IB schools enter students for the May session and set their own DP2 mock dates several months earlier, tuition in that window typically shifts toward structured past-paper practice, timed conditions, and command-term technique (define, describe, explain, evaluate, discuss, to what extent) rather than new content. IGCSE students preparing for Cambridge's February/March, May/June or Edexcel's January or May/June series follow a similar shift, working from past papers and mark schemes sourced through the school or official channels.

acceptedAnswer.text: Some tutors genuinely teach across both stages well, but many families end up with a different tutor for IGCSE and for the DP, because the two demand different things: IGCSE tuition centres on Core versus Extended tier decisions and building foundational technique, while DP tuition works from command terms, Higher Level depth, and assessment criteria for the IA, EE and TOK. contentBlocks.heading: Which IB or IGCSE Programme Is Your Child Actually In?
contentBlocks.body:
A home tutor's usefulness depends entirely on knowing which of these structures your child is actually working inside, so it is worth being precise rather than saying IB or IGCSE generally. IGCSE in Gurgaon almost always means either Cambridge IGCSE, set by Cambridge International Education, or Pearson Edexcel International GCSE, usually taken across Grade 9 and Grade 10. The two are graded differently: Cambridge grades most syllabuses A* to G, though some now carry 9-1 versions under separate codes, while Edexcel International GCSE grades every subject on the 9 to 1 scale.

The IB Middle Years Programme sits earlier, MYP 1 to MYP 5 across roughly five years, and marks every subject against four criteria, A to D, each out of 8, with the criterion total out of 32 converting into a final 1 to 7 grade through the IB's own boundaries. MYP 5 usually adds the Personal Project, sometimes preceded by a Community Project in MYP 3 or MYP 4, and some schools also offer an optional MYP eAssessment of on-screen exams and ePortfolios.

The Diploma Programme follows for most: two years, DP1 and DP2, six subjects across six groups, three or four at Higher Level with around 240 recommended teaching hours and the rest at Standard Level with around 150 hours. Each subject is graded 1 to 7, Theory of Knowledge and the Extended Essay together add up to 3 more points toward a 45 maximum, and 24 is the minimum for the diploma itself, subject to the IB's failing conditions, alongside Creativity, Activity, Service. A home tutor moving with a student from IGCSE into DP1 has to recalibrate almost everything about how they mark written work, since criterion-based and mark-scheme-based grading are simply different disciplines.

contentBlocks.heading: How Subject Depth Separates a Real Specialist From a Generalist
contentBlocks.body:
What separates a genuine subject specialist from a general home tutor becomes obvious the moment marking starts. A DP Economics essay is not judged on how fluent the writing is; it is judged against specific evaluation criteria set out in the syllabus, and a tutor unfamiliar with those criteria will mark generously in the wrong places and harshly in the right ones. The same is true of English Language, where structure, register and voice matter as much as accuracy, and a tutor working from a CBSE mindset can miss what the syllabus is actually rewarding.

Cambridge IGCSE Sciences, Biology, Chemistry and Physics among them, frequently split into Core and Extended tiers, and the tier decision shapes the entire ceiling of what grade is realistically reachable, Core capping at grade C and Extended reaching A*. A home tutor should be part of that tier conversation early in Grade 9, not brought in afterward to manage a decision already made without them.

Command terms carry real weight across both boards: define asks for a fact, describe asks for detail without reasoning, evaluate and to what extent ask for a weighed judgement, and a student who answers every question the same way, regardless of the term used, is leaving marks on the table regardless of subject knowledge. Past papers, mark schemes and subject reports, taken from the school or the relevant board's or the IB's own official channels, remain the clearest way for a tutor to show a student exactly where marks were lost and why, rather than guessing at what examiners want.

Online tutoring earns its place too, particularly where the right specialist for a niche DP subject, say Psychology HL or a less common language, simply does not live within reach of your corridor. A shared screen and annotated past papers cover most subject content perfectly well, and an online session that starts at the scheduled time removes the one variable a home visit cannot fully control, Gurgaon's evening traffic.

Hybrid arrangements, splitting the week between a home visit and an online session, suit a large share of families here in practice: closer, hands-on work for an Extended Essay draft or an IA outline happens in person, while routine revision and past-paper practice move online without losing much. A family on Golf Course Extension Road or deep into Sohna Road, where a short trip can stretch considerably once evening traffic builds, often finds this the more dependable weekly pattern than committing every single session to a home visit. Whichever pattern a household settles on, the point of an IB and IGCSE home tutor in Gurgaon is that the arrangement bends to the family's week, rather than the family reshaping its week around one fixed idea of what tuition should look like.

contentBlocks.heading: How to Tell a Home Tutor Is Actually Helping
contentBlocks.body:
Judging whether a home tutor is actually helping takes longer than most families expect, and it is worth being honest about that from the first session. No tutor, regardless of experience, can promise a particular grade, a mark boundary or a guaranteed improvement, and any claim to the contrary is worth treating with real caution. What a family can reasonably watch for instead is a shrinking error log: the same mistake, a misapplied command term, a repeated slip in working, showing up less often as the weeks pass.

Confidence often moves before marks do. A student who stops dreading a Maths session, or who finally submits an Extended Essay outline without three rounds of second-guessing, is showing real progress even before a test score reflects it. A full term, roughly ten to twelve weeks, is a fairer measure of whether a tutor is genuinely the right fit than the first two or three sessions, which mostly measure how quickly the pair settled into a working rhythm together.

If, after a fair trial, a subject still is not moving, staying with the same tutor out of politeness helps nobody, least of all the student. Changing tutors partway through a term is not unusual and is not treated by IB Gram as a failure of the earlier match; it is simply the next step, built the same way the first request was, from board, level, subject and slot, subject to who is currently available.

The shortlist you get usually has two or three profiles, each with a short note on why it fits: subject depth, which board they know best, and whether your sector sits comfortably inside their existing weekly route across Gurgaon.

contentBlocks.heading: IB MYP, DP and IGCSE: Mapping the Programme Your Child Is In
contentBlocks.body:
Home tuition works best when it is built around the exact stage your child is in, and in Gurgaon that usually means one of three structures. The IB Middle Years Programme runs across five years, MYP 1 to MYP 5, covering roughly ages eleven to sixteen across eight subject groups. Every subject is marked against four criteria, A to D, each scored out of 8, and the total out of 32 converts to a final grade of 1 to 7 through the IB's own grade boundaries. MYP 5 usually brings the Personal Project, with a Community Project sometimes set earlier in MYP 3 or MYP 4, and an optional MYP eAssessment of on-screen examinations and ePortfolios that each school decides whether to offer.

The IB Diploma Programme follows for many Gurgaon students: two years, DP1 and DP2, across six subjects from six groups, with three or four taken at Higher Level, around 240 recommended teaching hours, and the rest at Standard Level, around 150 hours. Each subject is graded 1 to 7, and Theory of Knowledge together with the Extended Essay add up to 3 more points, taking the maximum score to 45, with 24 the minimum for the diploma itself, subject to the IB's own failing conditions. Creativity, Activity, Service, known as CAS, has to be completed alongside the academic subjects, and most Gurgaon IB schools sit the May exam session rather than November.

IGCSE in Gurgaon usually means either Cambridge IGCSE, run by Cambridge International Education, or Pearson Edexcel International GCSE, and both typically run as a two-year course across Grade 9 and Grade 10. Many families then move to the IB Diploma Programme, to A Levels, or back to CBSE or ISC for Class 11, and this is exactly where a single home tutor often cannot cover both stages well. A tutor strong at IGCSE Extended content does not automatically know how DP1 raises the bar on independent analysis, so IB and IGCSE home tuition in Gurgaon for a family with children on both boards often means two different tutors working from the same household, each matched to their own stage rather than one generalist stretched across both.

contentBlocks.heading: What Do IB and IGCSE Subjects Actually Assess?
contentBlocks.body:
What an IB or IGCSE subject actually rewards is different from what a CBSE test usually rewards, and this is where a generalist home tutor can struggle. DP command terms, define, describe, explain, evaluate, discuss and to what extent, set how deep an answer needs to go, and a student who writes a strong describe answer when the question asks the student to evaluate will lose marks regardless of how accurate the content is. Past papers, mark schemes and subject reports, sourced through the school or the IB's own official channels, are the clearest way to see exactly how marks are awarded, and a home tutor should be working from these rather than from a general textbook.

MYP assessment adds another layer families new to the programme often miss: instead of one overall percentage, each subject is judged against four criteria specific to that subject group, each scored 0 to 8, and the criterion total out of 32 is converted into the final 1 to 7 grade through IB grade boundaries. A home tutor working on MYP Sciences, for instance, needs to know which criterion a piece of work is being judged against before deciding how to mark it, not just whether the answer is correct.

Cambridge IGCSE splits many subjects into Core and Extended tiers, where Core tops out at grade C and Extended can reach A*, so choosing the right tier is itself a decision a tutor should help with rather than assume. Edexcel International GCSE grades on a 9 to 1 scale across most syllabuses without the same Core and Extended split. Exam series also differ: Cambridge offers a February/March series available only in India alongside the May/June and October/November series, while Edexcel International GCSE runs in January and May/June, and a home tutor pacing revision needs to know which series your child is actually entered for before building a timeline back from it.

contentBlocks.heading: School Calendars That Shape Home Tuition Timing in Gurgaon
contentBlocks.body:
Families choosing IB and IGCSE home tuition in Gurgaon are often also juggling a school calendar that does not pause for tuition planning. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named here, the International Baccalaureate, Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel. Schools such as Pathways World School Aravali, Pathways School Gurgaon, Lancers International School, Scottish High International School, GD Goenka World School, Heritage Xperiential Learning School, The Shri Ram School Aravali and DPS International Edge are named here only as local context, since families across Gurgaon deal with broadly similar calendar pressures around exam seasons, mocks and project deadlines, not because IB Gram has any relationship with them or knowledge of which curriculum or board any one of them follows.

DP2 mock examinations usually fall several months before the May session, and each school sets its own dates, which means the winter term is often the tightest stretch of the two years, with mocks, university application deadlines and ongoing coursework landing close together. A Personal Project deadline in MYP 5, or a Community Project in MYP 3 or MYP 4, tends to land in the same term as ordinary coursework, and a home tutor who knows this in advance can help pace the term rather than let both deadlines collide in the same fortnight. contentBlocks.heading: Home, Online or Hybrid: What Actually Works for This Family?
contentBlocks.body:
For most families asking about IB and IGCSE home tuition in Gurgaon, home tuition is the starting point, and for good reason. A tutor sitting beside your child at the same desk can see exactly where a working step goes wrong in a Maths IA calculation or where an essay plan loses its argument, and correcting that in real time, on paper, tends to stick better than correcting it after the fact on a screen. Home tuition also suits younger students, MYP students in particular, who often need a visible, familiar routine more than an efficient one.

Online tuition is not a lesser option, though, and for some subjects it is genuinely the better one. If the strongest available tutor for a specific DP Higher Level subject does not live near your corridor, IB and IGCSE online tuition in Gurgaon lets you access that specialist without asking them to cross the city on a weekday evening. A shared digital whiteboard and annotated past papers work perfectly well for most subject content, and online sessions are far easier to reschedule when a school activity runs late.

Hybrid tuition, splitting sessions between home and online across the week, is often the honest middle ground: a subject that needs close marking, an Extended Essay draft or an IA outline, works better in person, while routine practice and past paper review can move online without losing much. Evening traffic on corridors such as Golf Course Extension Road and Sohna Road can stretch what should be a short trip considerably, and a family in New Gurgaon or on Dwarka Expressway will often find hybrid the most realistic weekly pattern rather than committing to home tuition every single session.

contentBlocks.heading: Verifying a Tutor Before the First Home Visit
contentBlocks.body:
Before any regular schedule is fixed, IB Gram verifies that a tutor's profile matches the syllabus and level you actually need, not just the board in general terms. That means checking which specific IGCSE syllabus code or DP subject group the tutor has taught before, since IB experience can mean anything from a single MYP term to several years of DP Higher Level teaching. A tutor's availability for a home visit, including which corridors they already cover, is confirmed before a profile is shortlisted to you.

Parents should verify a few things themselves too, alongside whatever IB Gram checks. Ask the tutor directly which syllabus and tier or level they have taught, and ask for a specific example, a topic they have recently covered, rather than a general answer. Ask whether they can work from your school's own scheme of work and pacing, since a tutor teaching to a different school's timeline can leave your child either behind or repeating content already covered in class.

A free trial class before any commitment is the single most useful check available, and it is worth treating it as more than a formality. Watch how the tutor handles a question your child gets wrong, not just how they explain a question your child gets right. Confirm in advance who will be home during the first few sessions, particularly for a younger student or a first tutor, and agree what happens if a session is missed, whether it moves online, moves to another evening, or is simply skipped that week.

contentBlocks.heading: Fixing a Stable Weekly Home Tuition Slot in Gurgaon
contentBlocks.body:
Fixing a stable weekly home tuition slot in Gurgaon is less about finding a free hour and more about finding one that survives contact with a real school week. Start by ruling out the evenings school buses, sports practice or a weekly activity already claim, then look at what is left. A slot that only just fits, squeezed between pickup and dinner, tends to fall apart within a month once one late day happens, so it is worth choosing a slot with fifteen minutes of slack on either side rather than the tightest possible fit.

Corridor pairing matters here too. A tutor who already teaches in DLF Phase 5 on Golf Course Road can often add a Golf Course Extension Road family in the same evening without much extra travel, since the two corridors sit close together, while a tutor based near Sohna Road pairs more naturally with Sushant Lok or South City 1 than with New Gurgaon on the far side of the city. This is part of why IB Gram asks for your sector early: it shapes which tutors can actually hold a stable weekly time for you rather than a shifting one.

Once a slot is fixed, treat the first month as a trial of the slot itself, not just the tutor. If Tuesday evenings keep getting disrupted by a clashing activity, move the slot rather than persisting out of habit. During an exam week or a period of heavy school coursework, swapping a fixed home evening for a shorter online session, rather than cancelling it outright, keeps the routine going without adding to an already full week, and switching back to home tuition once the pressure eases is simple enough when the tutor already knows the family.

contentBlocks.heading: What a Term of Home Tuition Should Actually Show
contentBlocks.body:
What progress looks like after a term of IB and IGCSE home tuition in Gurgaon is rarely a single dramatic jump in marks, and it is worth setting that expectation early. No tutor, however experienced, can guarantee a grade, a score or a mark boundary, and any claim that suggests otherwise is worth being sceptical of. A more honest early signal is a shorter, more consistent error log: the same type of mistake, a sign error in a Maths working, a missed command term in a DP essay, showing up less often across a few weeks of sessions.

Confidence in a draft Extended Essay outline, an oral response, or a first attempt at an Internal Assessment often improves before raw marks visibly catch up, since a student stops second-guessing the structure of an answer before they get faster at producing the content itself. A term, roughly ten to twelve weeks, is a fair length of time before judging whether a particular subject tutor is genuinely working, since a shorter window mostly measures how quickly a student settled in rather than how well the tuition itself is going.

'The best IB and IGCSE home tuition in Gurgaon' is not a label any platform can honestly award itself; it is closer to a fit that keeps working across a full term, checked against a school's own tests and your child's own working, not against a ranking. If a subject genuinely is not improving after a fair trial, changing the tutor is a reasonable next step rather than a failure, and IB Gram treats that request the same way it treats the first one: back to board, level and slot, not a fresh start from nothing.

contentBlocks.heading: Starting IB and IGCSE Home Tuition in Gurgaon This Term
contentBlocks.body:
Getting started with IB and IGCSE home tuition in Gurgaon works best when you arrive at the first conversation with a few basics ready. Know your child's board and level precisely, DP1 or DP2, MYP year, or Grade 9 or Grade 10 IGCSE, and which specific syllabus, since IGCSE alone does not tell IB Gram whether that means Cambridge or Edexcel. Name the subject or subjects that need attention rather than asking generally for help with school, since a shortlist built around a specific gap is a faster, better match than a broad one.

Mention your sector or society early too, whether that is a society off Golf Course Road, a home on Sohna Road, or a flat further out on Dwarka Expressway, since travel realism is part of the shortlist from the first conversation rather than a surprise once a tutor is chosen. Decide in advance whether you want the first session at home or online, and block a proper slot for the free trial class rather than squeezing it into a spare twenty minutes, since a trial that gets rushed tells you very little about how the tutor and your child actually work together.

From there, the process is straightforward: a shortlist of two or three verified profiles, a trial class, and a regular weekly slot once the fit feels right. Ask any question before the trial begins, about pacing, about materials, about how the tutor marks a Maths working or an essay draft, since a tutor who answers those questions clearly usually teaches the same way. And if, a few weeks in, the match is not quite right, IB Gram can arrange a different tutor, subject to availability, rather than leaving a family to persist with something that is not working.

faqs.question: Does IB and IGCSE home tuition in Gurgaon really work, or is online just as good?
faqs.answer: Both work, and which is better depends on the subject and the student rather than on one being universally superior. Home tuition tends to suit younger MYP students and subjects that benefit from a shared notebook or whiteboard, while online tuition often gives access to a stronger specialist for a specific DP Higher Level subject who does not live near your corridor. Many Gurgaon families end up with a hybrid pattern, home tuition for some subjects or sessions and online for others, rather than choosing one exclusively.

faqs.question: My child has shown no real progress after a month of tuition. What should we do?
faqs.answer: A month is usually too short to judge fairly; a full term, roughly ten to twelve weeks, gives a more honest picture. If there is still no change by then, look first at whether the tutor matches the exact syllabus and tier your child is on, since a mismatch there can look like a teaching problem when it is actually a fit problem. If the syllabus match is right and progress is still absent, ask IB Gram for a different tutor rather than persisting out of habit.

faqs.question: Can a home tutor cover both IGCSE and the IB Diploma Programme for our two children?
faqs.answer: Sometimes, but often a family needs two different tutors even for the same subject area, since the marking style and workload change significantly between IGCSE Grade 10 and DP1. A tutor strong at Cambridge IGCSE Extended content does not automatically know how DP raises the bar on independent analysis and Internal Assessment work, so IB Gram usually matches each child separately against their own board and level rather than assuming one tutor suits both.

faqs.question: Will a home tutor travel to our society on the Sohna Road stretch near Badshahpur?

IB Gram takes your society into account when building the shortlist, and where no tutor already covers that exact stretch, a hybrid pattern, home sessions some weeks and online sessions others, is usually offered as a realistic alternative rather than leaving the slot unfilled.

faqs.question: Does a parent need to be home during the tuition session?
faqs.answer: It is not compulsory, but most families choose to have someone home, particularly for a younger student or during the first few sessions with a new tutor. Whether a parent sits in the room or simply is present in the flat is entirely your call and can be agreed with the tutor directly. What matters more is that the study space is quiet and has what the session needs, a desk, a calculator for Maths, or a laptop for research work.

faqs.question: What happens if a home tuition session is missed because of school or travel?
faqs.answer: A missed session can usually be rescheduled to another evening that week or moved online instead of being cancelled outright, and it is worth agreeing this pattern with the tutor before it happens rather than after. Families on corridors with heavier evening traffic, such as Golf Course Extension Road, sometimes prearrange a short online session as the default backup for exactly this reason, so one bad traffic evening does not mean losing the week's session entirely.

faqs.question: Can we switch from CBSE to the IGCSE to IB DP path with home tuition support?
faqs.answer: Yes, and it is common enough that IB Gram treats it as a normal request rather than an unusual one. The main adjustment is less about content and more about assessment style; command terms, criteria-based marking in MYP, and mark-scheme-driven answers in IGCSE and DP all differ from how CBSE tests are typically structured, and a home tutor experienced with that shift can make the first term noticeably less disorienting for the student.
