heroSubtitle: IB Gram matches verified private tutors to families across Gurgaon, corridor by corridor. Golf Course Road, Sohna Road, Southern Peripheral Road, New Gurgaon, Dwarka Expressway, Old Gurgaon and Manesar each schedule differently on a weekday evening. This page explains where home tuition is practical, which sectors pair inside one tutor's route, and when online is the better call.
introSummary: An IB IGCSE private tutor Gurgaon families engage directly is a private arrangement outside the school: one verified tutor, one student, usually home tuition at the family's own address in their own sector. Where that works well depends less on the subject than on the map. A home tutor on Golf Course Road can hold a six-thirty slot in DLF Phase 5 and a later one in Sector 53 on the same evening. The same tutor cannot add Sector 102 on the Dwarka Expressway to that night. So this page is organised by corridor: what each one means for gate entry, bus timings and traffic, which sectors pair inside one weekly route, and where an online or hybrid week is the honest answer instead of home classes.

contentBlocks.heading: How does a weekly slot get fixed around Gurgaon traffic?
contentBlocks.body:
By starting with the slot and working backwards to the tutor. You give us the corridor, the time the school bus actually drops your child, and the evenings already taken by sport or music. We then shortlist verified tutors whose existing weekly route can absorb your address on those evenings.

A request for an IB IGCSE private tutor Gurgaon parents can actually schedule starts with three lines of information: board and level, the sector or society, and the earliest hour the student is home, fed and able to think. Board and level decide who is qualified. The sector decides who is reachable. The third line decides whether the lesson is worth holding at all, because a Middle Years Programme (MYP) 3 student who reaches Sushant Lok 1 late and hungry will not give anyone a useful ninety minutes at eight o'clock.

The numbered steps below are the whole process, and nothing else happens behind them. The consultation is free, the shortlist is drawn from profiles that have been verified, and a demo or trial session can be arranged before any commitment. Slots stay subject to tutor availability, and Friday evenings anywhere along Sohna Road tend to be the hardest ones to fill, because that road carries weekend traffic early.

One honest warning before you send anything. Sometimes there is no home tutor with the right board experience who can reach your address on the evening you need. A Diploma Programme (DP) Higher Level (HL) Chemistry specialist is a narrower pool than a general Class 10 tutor, and narrowing it further by corridor and by hour can empty it completely. When that happens we say so, and offer the same tutor online, or a hybrid week with one home visit and one screen session. It is better to hear that on day one than to accept a tutor who starts cancelling by the third week.

contentBlocks.heading: MYP, DP and IGCSE: which stage the household is actually in
contentBlocks.body:
IGCSE in Gurgaon means either Cambridge IGCSE, from Cambridge International Education, or the Pearson Edexcel International GCSE. It is usually a two-year course across Grades 9 and 10, often followed by the International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma Programme (DP), A Levels, or a move to CBSE or ISC in Class 11. Cambridge series run in February/March, a series offered only in India, in May/June and in October/November. Edexcel International GCSE series run in January and in May/June.

Cambridge grades most syllabuses A* to G, and some syllabuses have 9-1 versions under different codes. Edexcel International GCSE grades 9 to 1. Many Cambridge subjects are tiered: Core tops out at grade C, Extended reaches A*. That one decision changes what a home tutor should be doing all year. A student parked in Core who is capable of Extended is being taught to a ceiling. A student pushed into Extended too early spends the year drowning in questions they cannot begin.

The MYP runs five years, MYP 1 to 5, roughly ages eleven to sixteen, across eight subject groups. Every subject is assessed against four criteria, A to D, each scored 0 to 8. The criterion total out of 32 converts to a final 1 to 7 grade through IB grade boundaries. The Personal Project lands in MYP 5 and the Community Project in MYP 3 or 4. MYP eAssessment in MYP 5, on-screen examinations plus ePortfolios, is optional, and each school decides whether to offer it.

The DP is two years, DP1 and DP2: six subjects from six groups, three or four at Higher Level (HL, 240 recommended teaching hours) and the rest at Standard Level (SL, 150 hours), each graded 1 to 7. Theory of Knowledge (TOK) and the Extended Essay (EE) combine for up to 3 more points, so 45 is the maximum and 24 the minimum for the diploma, subject to the IB's failing conditions. Creativity, Activity, Service (CAS) must also be completed. Most Gurgaon IB schools enter students for the May session; November is used by a minority of schools and by retake candidates, and May results are released in early July.

Two stages, two different tutors, more often than families expect. The move from Grade 10 into DP1 changes the marking and not only the difficulty, so an IGCSE to IB DP transition tutor for the older child and a separate subject tutor for the younger one is a common arrangement. A single IB and IGCSE tutor Gurgaon households share between two children rarely serves both stages equally well.
items: Cambridge series: February/March in India only, May/June, and October/November
Pearson Edexcel International GCSE series run in January and in May/June
MYP: four criteria per subject, each 0-8, totalling 32 before conversion
DP: six subjects, three or four at Higher Level, maximum 45 points
TOK and the Extended Essay together contribute up to three points
Cambridge Core tops out at grade C; Extended reaches A*

contentBlocks.heading: Subject depth: papers, criteria and the command terms that decide marks
contentBlocks.body:
Marks in both boards are awarded against published wording, not against effort. Command terms set the depth an answer needs: define, describe, explain, evaluate, discuss, to what extent. A student who writes a careful description where the paper asked them to evaluate has answered a different question, and no amount of extra reading repairs that. A good home tutor often spends the first month on this alone.

In the MYP, each subject is marked against criteria A to D, 0 to 8 each. A Sciences task marked against the criterion for inquiring and designing does not reward a correct result; it rewards a testable hypothesis, controlled variables and a method another student could repeat. Children arriving from a board where the final answer carries the marks lose a band or two before they understand this. The total out of 32 then converts to a 1 to 7 through IB grade boundaries, which is why a child can improve on every criterion and still see the same number on the term report.

At DP, the gap between HL and SL is 240 recommended teaching hours against 150, and that gap is content and depth rather than pace alone. Internal Assessment (IA) work absorbs most home tuition time in DP1 and early DP2, because an IA is marked against criteria the student can read in advance and plan towards. The EE and TOK carry up to 3 points between them. A tutor can teach the skill of building and testing an argument for TOK, and can question a student's EE research question until it becomes answerable, without touching the writing itself.

Across IGCSE subjects, the paper structure follows the tier the school entered the student for, and the syllabus code printed on your school booklist is the only reliable guide to which papers apply. Past papers, mark schemes and subject reports come through the school or the IB's official channels, and they show exactly how marks are awarded. Ask the tutor to work from those, in front of the student, rather than from a private question bank of unknown origin. A student who has seen three mark schemes annotated properly stops guessing what an examiner wants.

MYP criteria A to D are marked 0-8 each, then converted
Higher Level is 240 recommended hours against 150 at Standard Level
Internal Assessment criteria are published, so a student can plan towards them

contentBlocks.heading: Gurgaon corridor by corridor: sectors, societies and the evening slot
contentBlocks.body:
Golf Course Road covers DLF Phase 5, DLF Phase 1, Sector 42, Sector 43, Sector 53, Sector 54, Ardee City and Wazirabad, with high-rise addresses such as DLF The Magnolias, DLF The Aralias, DLF Park Place, DLF The Crest and DLF The Belaire. Home tuition here is simple on paper and slow in practice: the gates are strict, visitor registration runs through an app in most towers, and a tutor who has not been pre-registered can lose a quarter of the lesson at the boundary. Golf Course Extension Road runs from Sector 56, Sector 57, Sector 58, Sector 59 and Sector 60 through Sector 62 and Sector 65, with Sushant Lok 3, Ghata and Gwal Pahari at the edges, and societies including M3M Golf Estate, Ireo Grand Arch and Ireo Skyon. This is the easiest corridor to serve back to back, because the addresses sit in a line.

Sohna Road takes in Sector 47, Sector 48, Sector 49 and Sector 50, plus Nirvana Country, South City 2, Rosewood City, Uppal Southend, Vatika Chowk and Badshahpur, with Central Park Resorts, Orchid Petals, Vatika City, Malibu Towne, Vipul Greens and The Close along its length. Evening traffic towards Vatika Chowk and Badshahpur can stretch a short trip badly, so a tutor arriving from the north belongs in the later slot here rather than the first one. DLF Phase 2, DLF Phase 3 and DLF Phase 4, MG Road, Cyber City, Sikanderpur, Chakkarpur, Sector 24, Sector 27 and Sector 28 present a different problem: office traffic instead of school traffic. DLF Beverly Park, Heritage City, DLF Hamilton Court, DLF Regency Park, DLF Richmond Park and Ambience Caitriona are all reachable, but the early evening window around Cyber City is the worst of the day.

Sushant Lok 1, Sushant Lok 2, South City 1, Sector 29, Sector 40, Sector 45, Sector 46 and Greenwood City sit in the middle of the city and are the most forgiving addresses for home classes, because a tutor can arrive from almost any direction without crossing a choke point. Southern Peripheral Road, with Sector 66, Sector 67, Sector 68, Sector 69, Sector 70 and Sector 72, along with Ansal Esencia, Bhondsi and Tata Primanti, is quick when it is clear and punishing when it is not; a fixed early slot holds far better here than a late one.

New Gurgaon covers Sector 82, Sector 83, Sector 84, Sector 85 and Sector 86, Sector 89 and Sector 90, Kherki Daula and Pataudi Road, with Vatika India Next and Godrej Air. The Dwarka Expressway side runs from Sector 102, Sector 103 and Sector 104 through Sector 106, Sector 108, Sector 109, Sector 110 and Sector 113, with Godrej Summit, Sobha City and ATS Kocoon. Both are well served at weekends and thinner on weekday evenings, because a tutor teaching on Golf Course Road at six cannot be here by eight. Old Gurgaon and Palam Vihar, meaning Palam Vihar itself, Civil Lines, Sadar Bazar, Jacobpura, Rajendra Park, Ashok Vihar, Sector 4, Sector 14, Sector 15, Sector 22 and Sector 23, have short internal distances and independent houses rather than tower gates, which makes entry the simplest in the city. Manesar and NH-48 south, including IMT Manesar, Hero Honda Chowk, Sector 33, Sector 34 and Sector 37, is the one corridor where we say plainly that an online or hybrid week is usually the sensible default in term time. All of this is still Gurugram (Gurgaon), Haryana, and none of it behaves like one city after five in the evening.

contentBlocks.heading: What the Gurgaon school calendar does to your tutoring week
contentBlocks.body:
School timings, buses and the exam calendar fix your slot more firmly than anything else does. Children at international schools in Gurgaon often board a bus early and reach home well after the last period, especially from schools on the outer edges of the city, and a home tutor booked before that bus lands is simply waiting in your drawing room. An IB and IGCSE tutor in Gurgaon who already teaches in your corridor will usually know the rough rhythm of these evenings and will ask about the bus before asking about the subject.

Families here deal with names such as Pathways World School, Aravali, Pathways School Gurgaon, Lancers International School, Scottish High International School, GD Goenka World School, Heritage Xperiential Learning School, The Shri Ram School, Aravali and DPS International Edge. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named here, the International Baccalaureate, Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel. We do not speak for any school's programme or entry decisions, and you should confirm every calendar detail with your own school coordinator rather than with a tutor.

Each school sets its own DP2 mock examination dates, usually several months before May, and those weeks bend every tutoring timetable in the house. Most Gurgaon IB schools enter students for the May session, so the pressure curve across the city runs broadly the same way: quiet in the first term, tight from mocks onwards, finished in early July when May results are released. Cambridge families have more dates to hold in their heads, because Cambridge series run in February/March, May/June and October/November, and the February/March series is offered only in India.

Then there is everything that is not academic. Football, music, debate practice, the swimming slot at the society pool. Parents tend to describe these as flexible and then discover they are the fixed points around which home tuition has to move. Write the entire week down once, including the bus return window and the two evenings nobody will give up, before you book a tutor at all. It saves the second reshuffle and the third one, and it is the single most useful thing a parent can do before the first call.

contentBlocks.heading: Home tuition, online or hybrid: which one suits your corridor?
contentBlocks.body:
Home tuition comes first, because it is what most families here want and what IB Gram leads with: a verified tutor at your own table, in your own sector, on a fixed weekday evening. It wins on attention, on a student who cannot quietly open another tab, and on the small diagnostic signals a tutor picks up only in person, such as which questions the student skips before anyone is watching.

But home tuition is bought at the price of travel, and travel is what breaks slots. A home tutor crossing from Sector 43 to Sector 108 on a Wednesday evening spends more of the week on the road than with your child, and that cost eventually shows up as cancellations. Along Golf Course Road, Golf Course Extension Road, Sushant Lok and Sohna Road, home classes hold well through a full term. In Manesar, in the far Dwarka Expressway sectors and in the Sector 89 to Sector 90 pocket of New Gurgaon, an IB and IGCSE online tutor Gurgaon families book for weeknights is often the more reliable arrangement, with the home session kept for a Saturday.

Online is not a lesser lesson. It is a different one. A shared whiteboard, a scanned past paper annotated live, and a recording the student can replay the night before a mock are real advantages that a home session does not offer. What online loses is the corner of the eye: the tutor cannot see the notebook margin filling with doodles, and a younger MYP student usually needs an adult somewhere in the room to keep the session honest. Bandwidth in most Gurgaon high-rises is fine. The problem is more often the device and the room.

Hybrid is where most long-running arrangements settle by the second term. One home visit each week for teaching and marking, one online session for doubt-solving and past-paper work, and an extra screen session added before mocks without anyone crossing the city twice in an evening. It is also the arrangement that survives a monsoon week, a waterlogged underpass and a tutor whose other student has a test the same night.
items: Home tuition holds best on Golf Course Road, Sushant Lok and Sohna Road
Online is the reliable default in Manesar and the far Dwarka Expressway sectors
Hybrid: one home visit for teaching, one screen session for past papers
Younger MYP students need an adult nearby during an online lesson
A second device for the shared whiteboard changes an online session completely

contentBlocks.heading: How is an IB IGCSE private tutor Gurgaon families let in verified?
contentBlocks.body:
Profiles are verified before they reach a shortlist: identity, qualifications, and the boards and levels the tutor claims to teach. That is the platform's part of the work. Your part happens at your own gate and matters just as much, because you are giving an adult regular access to your home and to a child. An IB IGCSE private tutor Gurgaon families let through a society gate every week should be someone they have already met once, in a trial, with their own eyes.

Ask for identification at the society gate on the first visit, and register the tutor formally instead of waving them through as a guest. Most Gurgaon towers now run visitor entry through an app, and a tutor added as a recurring visitor for a fixed weekday slot gets in without a phone call every week. In independent houses in Palam Vihar, Civil Lines or Sector 15 there is no gate to manage, so the checking is entirely yours and worth doing properly.

Then check the teaching rather than the résumé. Put a marked past paper or a returned MYP criterion sheet in front of the tutor during the trial and ask what the examiner was actually rewarding. A specialist answers in the language of the mark scheme and the command terms. A generalist talks about the topic. Ask which exam series your child's school enters, and what the tutor will do differently in the eight weeks before mocks. IB and IGCSE tutors in Gurgaon vary more by board experience than by years taught.

Two things no verification can do. It cannot promise a grade, and no tutor honestly can. And it cannot tell you whether this particular adult and this particular teenager will work well together, which is exactly why a demo or trial session exists and why you can ask for a different match if the fit is wrong. Say it early if you feel it. A quiet, unhappy arrangement that runs for two terms costs a family far more than one awkward conversation in week three.
items: Identity, qualifications and the boards and levels claimed are checked before shortlisting
Register the tutor at your society gate as a recurring weekly visitor
Ask the tutor to read a marked paper against the real mark scheme
Ask which exam series your school enters and what changes before mocks
No tutor can guarantee a grade; treat any such promise as a warning

contentBlocks.heading: Why your sector decides the IB and IGCSE home tuition slot in Gurugram
contentBlocks.body:
A weekly slot is a piece of geography before it is a piece of the timetable. Type IB IGCSE private tutor Gurgaon into a phone in Sector 57 and then in Sector 102, and the honest answer is not the same, because the tutors who can reach those two addresses at seven on a Tuesday are almost entirely different people.

Work it out from the tutor's side once and the whole thing becomes obvious. A tutor teaching a full week holds perhaps two lessons on a weekday evening, and those two have to sit on one arc of the city. That is why an IB IGCSE private tutor Golf Course Road families book will usually also have students in Sector 53 and DLF Phase 1; why an IB IGCSE private tutor Golf Course Extension Road parents hire tends to cover Sector 57 through Sector 65 and Sushant Lok 3; and why an IB IGCSE private tutor Sohna Road serves Sector 49, Nirvana Country and Malibu Towne rather than crossing to the Dwarka Expressway on the same night.

Inside the corridor, the gate is the next constraint. A visitor pass in DLF The Crest or Tata Primanti is a different process from walking up to a house in Rajendra Park. Register the tutor once as a recurring visitor for a named day and hour and the friction disappears; leave it to the guard each week and you will lose minutes off every lesson and eventually the tutor. Ask your society office what they need before the first session rather than during it.

Direction matters as much as distance. Evening traffic runs heavily towards the residential south and east, so a tutor travelling outward with the flow arrives late while a tutor travelling against it arrives early, from the same starting point. The school bus return window is the other fixed edge, because no useful home class starts before the child is home, changed and fed. Between those two edges there is usually one hour that genuinely works, and the arrangement lives or dies on whether the family protects it.

And this is a private arrangement, made by you, outside the school. It is not the school's remedial period and not its extra class, and a good tutor keeps the line clear: mapping lessons to the school's scheme of work without doing the school's tasks for the student, and keeping what the child struggles with between the house and the tutor. An international board tutor Gurugram families hire privately answers to the family, which is precisely why the slot, the route and the expectations should be agreed out loud at the start.
items: A tutor holds about two weekday evening lessons, and both sit on one arc
Evening traffic runs outward, so arrival depends on direction, not only distance
One recurring gate registration beats a guard call every single week
Lessons map to the school's scheme of work without doing the school's tasks
What the student struggles with stays between the family and the tutor

contentBlocks.heading: What the first four to six weeks should honestly show
contentBlocks.body:
Not a grade. A grade is a lagging signal, and in the MYP and the DP it is a converted one as well: a criterion total out of 32 becomes a 1 to 7 through boundaries the school applies, so a real improvement can sit inside the same number for an entire term. Judge the first month on things that surface sooner and that you can check yourself.

Week one should produce a diagnosis you can repeat back in your own words: which topics are missing, which command terms the student consistently misreads, whether the trouble is content or examination technique. By week three the student should be starting questions without a run-up, even when the answer goes wrong. By week six there should be one marked piece of work, against the real mark scheme or the real criteria, with the score explained line by line and the next target named. If none of that has happened, the arrangement is drifting and a conversation is overdue.

Review with the tutor every four to six weeks, briefly and in writing. Ask what has changed, what has not, and what they want from you at home. Feedback to parents is one of the quiet differences between a home tutor who is teaching and one who is turning up. There is no register anywhere that certifies the best IB IGCSE private tutor in Gurgaon, and any page claiming that title cannot support it, so judge yours on the marked work sitting on your own table.

Some families do not need a tutor at all. A DP student who understands the content and loses marks only to timing needs practice under a clock, not a second teacher. A Grade 9 student two months into IGCSE is often adjusting to an unfamiliar style of marking and will settle by the winter break without help. Starting late narrows what is possible: eight weeks before a May session, the honest goal is protecting the marks already within reach rather than adding a grade. Any tutor who promises more than that is selling you something.
items: Week one: a diagnosis you can repeat back in your own words
Week three: the student starts questions without waiting to be shown how
Week six: one piece marked against the real criteria, with the score explained
Review every four to six weeks, briefly and in writing
Eight weeks before a session protects marks rather than adding grades

contentBlocks.heading: Getting started: what to prepare before the first home class
contentBlocks.body:
Have four things ready and the first session is worth double: the school booklist with syllabus codes, the last report card, the school's test and mock calendar, and the exam series your child's school enters. The tutor can then plan from evidence instead of from a parent's summary of the problem, which is always kinder to the child than it is accurate.

Set up the room before the tutor arrives. A table, two chairs facing the same work, a plug point, decent light, and the phone in another room entirely. Kitchen tables work well. Beds do not. For an online or a hybrid week, add a second device for the shared whiteboard, because a student writing on the same screen they are watching loses half the session to switching between windows.

Handle the gate in advance. Tell your society office the tutor's name and the day and hour, and ask whether they want a recurring visitor entry or a fresh pass each week. In Nirvana Country, South City 1 or M3M Golf Estate this is one phone call made on a Sunday. Doing it during the first lesson instead takes fifteen minutes out of that lesson, and it repeats every week until somebody fixes it properly.

Then the first session itself. The tutor diagnoses more than they teach: a few questions from the current unit, a look at the last marked paper, a conversation about what the student believes is going wrong. You should receive a short plan afterwards naming what will be covered in the first month and what the tutor wants from you at home. Ask for it if it does not arrive. If a search for an IB IGCSE private tutor near me brought you to this page, that plan is what tells you whether the match is right, far more reliably than the distance between two sectors.
items: Booklist with syllabus codes, last report card, and the school test calendar
A table, two chairs, a plug point and the phone in another room
Tell the society office the tutor's name, day and hour in advance
For hybrid weeks, a second device for the shared whiteboard
Ask for a written plan naming the first month's topics and targets

faqs.question: Can a home tutor really reach Sector 57 on a weekday evening?
faqs.answer: Yes, Golf Course Extension Road is one of the easier corridors to serve on weeknights. Sector 56 through Sector 65, Sushant Lok 3 and societies such as Ireo Grand Arch and M3M Golf Estate sit close enough together that a tutor holding two lessons an evening can take one there and one nearby without crossing the city. The slot still depends on when the school bus drops your child and on tutor availability. Ask for the earlier of the two evening slots if your child fades after eight, and register the tutor at the gate before the first visit.

faqs.question: How does society gate entry work for a home tutor?
faqs.answer: Register the tutor once as a recurring visitor for a fixed day and hour, and the weekly friction disappears. Most Gurgaon high-rises, including towers along Golf Course Road and Southern Peripheral Road, run visitor entry through an app or a gate register, and an unregistered tutor can lose a chunk of the lesson waiting for a call to be answered. Give the society office the tutor's name and the schedule before the first session rather than on the evening itself. In independent houses in Palam Vihar or Sector 14 there is no gate process at all, so the checking is entirely yours.

faqs.question: What happens if a home session is missed because of traffic or rain?
faqs.answer: It gets rescheduled, and the sensible default is to move it online rather than lose the week. Gurgaon weeknights are unpredictable, and a waterlogged stretch near Vatika Chowk or Hero Honda Chowk can end an evening's teaching before it starts. Agree the rule at the beginning: how much notice each side gives, whether a missed session is made up at the weekend, and whether it converts to a screen session the same evening. Families who settle this in week one argue about it far less in month four, and the tutor plans their route more honestly.

faqs.question: Should a parent be at home during the lesson?
faqs.answer: For younger MYP students, yes; for DP students, not in the room. Someone should be at home while a tutor is in the house, which most families in Gurgaon treat as ordinary common sense. But a sixteen-year-old working on an Internal Assessment will not speak freely about what they do not understand with a parent listening from the next chair. Sit within earshot rather than inside the lesson. Ask for the plan and the marked work afterwards instead, because that tells you far more about the quality of the teaching than overhearing twenty minutes of it ever will.

faqs.question: Which Gurgaon corridors pair inside one tutor's weekly route?
faqs.answer: Golf Course Road with Golf Course Extension Road, Sohna Road with Southern Peripheral Road, New Gurgaon with the Dwarka Expressway sectors, and Old Gurgaon with Palam Vihar. Those pairs sit on the same arc, so a tutor can hold two lessons in one evening without a long crossing. Pairs that rarely work on a weekday include DLF Phase 5 with Sector 108, or almost anything with IMT Manesar. If your address falls into a pairing that does not exist yet, the realistic options are a weekend slot, an earlier weekday hour, or online through term time.

faqs.question: Is online better than home tuition for a Dwarka Expressway address?
faqs.answer: On weeknights, often yes; at weekends, usually not. Sector 102 to Sector 113, including Godrej Summit, Sobha City and ATS Kocoon, sits far enough from the older corridors that a tutor finishing a lesson on Golf Course Road cannot reach you at a workable hour. Many families here run an online arrangement on two weeknights and keep a longer home class on Saturday morning. You lose a little of what a tutor notices in person, and you gain a slot that actually happens every week instead of one that keeps slipping.

faqs.question: My child finishes IGCSE Grade 10 this year and starts DP1. Same tutor?
faqs.answer: Usually not the same tutor, and that surprises families. The two stages are marked differently: IGCSE subjects are graded on Cambridge's A* to G scales or Edexcel's 9 to 1, with Core and Extended tiers in many Cambridge subjects, while DP subjects are graded 1 to 7 with Internal Assessment work and, at Higher Level, 240 recommended teaching hours against 150 at Standard Level. A tutor strong on Extended past papers is not automatically strong on IA criteria. Many households keep a subject tutor for the younger child and add a separate DP specialist for the older one.

faqs.question: How many sessions a week, and how soon can a tutor start?
faqs.answer: One to two sessions a week per subject is the common pattern, rising before mocks and the May session. Start dates depend on tutor availability and on how unusual your slot is: a six o'clock request in Sushant Lok 1 is easier to fill than an eight o'clock request in Sector 90. Send the query with your corridor, board, level and two possible evenings, and the shortlist comes back faster because nobody is guessing at your constraints. A demo or trial session is arranged before you commit to any regular arrangement.

faqs.question: What does the free trial class actually cover?
faqs.answer: Diagnosis, not a sales pitch. The tutor works through a few questions from the current unit, looks at the last marked paper or criterion sheet, and asks the student what they think is going wrong. You should come away with a short plan for the first month and a clear sense of whether those two people can work together at all. Use the trial to test the things that matter: does the tutor talk in the language of the mark scheme and the command terms, and do they know which exam series your school enters?

faqs.question: The tutor is not working out. What do we do now?
faqs.answer: Say so, and ask for a different match. Nothing about the arrangement is locked, and a private tutor who is wrong for your child is a wrong that compounds every week it continues. Be specific about what is failing: travel and lateness, board knowledge, pace, or simply that the student has stopped talking during sessions. That detail makes the next shortlist better rather than merely different. An IB IGCSE private tutor Gurgaon families book through IB Gram is matched on board, level and route together, so a mismatch in any one of the three is worth naming.

faqs.question: Is a home tutor worth the travel compared with a nearby coaching centre?
faqs.answer: It depends on what your child is losing marks for. A batch costs less per hour by structure, because the cost is shared, and a motivated student who mainly needs pace and company can do well inside one. A student who misreads command terms, or who needs IA criteria unpicked line by line, will not get that in a full room. Home tuition costs more in structure and buys attention plus a slot fixed around your own week. Neither answer is right for every family in Gurgaon, and the trial is what settles it.

faqs.question: We live in Manesar. Is a weekday home tutor realistic for us?
faqs.answer: Honestly, not often during term time. IMT Manesar, Hero Honda Chowk, Sector 33, Sector 34 and Sector 37 sit far from where most tutors hold their other lessons, so a weekday evening slot is hard to fill and harder to keep for a full term. An IB IGCSE private tutor Gurugram families book for this side usually works one of two ways: a long weekend session at home, or online on weeknights with home visits before mocks. Ask for both options in your query rather than only the one you would prefer.

acceptedAnswer.text: It gets rescheduled, and the sensible default is to move it online rather than lose the week. Gurgaon weeknights are unpredictable, and a waterlogged stretch near Vatika Chowk or Hero Honda Chowk can end an evening's teaching before it starts. Agree the rule at the beginning: how much notice each side gives, whether a missed session is made up at the weekend, and whether it converts to a screen session the same evening. Families who settle this in week one argue about it far less in month four, and the tutor plans their route more honestly.

mainEntity.name: Should a parent be at home during the lesson?

acceptedAnswer.text: For younger MYP students, yes; for DP students, not in the room. Someone should be at home while a tutor is in the house, which most families in Gurgaon treat as ordinary common sense. But a sixteen-year-old working on an Internal Assessment will not speak freely about what they do not understand with a parent listening from the next chair. Sit within earshot rather than inside the lesson. Ask for the plan and the marked work afterwards instead, because that tells you far more about the quality of the teaching than overhearing twenty minutes of it ever will.

mainEntity.name: Which Gurgaon corridors pair inside one tutor's weekly route?

acceptedAnswer.text: Golf Course Road with Golf Course Extension Road, Sohna Road with Southern Peripheral Road, New Gurgaon with the Dwarka Expressway sectors, and Old Gurgaon with Palam Vihar. Those pairs sit on the same arc, so a tutor can hold two lessons in one evening without a long crossing. Pairs that rarely work on a weekday include DLF Phase 5 with Sector 108, or almost anything with IMT Manesar. If your address falls into a pairing that does not exist yet, the realistic options are a weekend slot, an earlier weekday hour, or online through term time.

mainEntity.name: Is online better than home tuition for a Dwarka Expressway address?

acceptedAnswer.text: On weeknights, often yes; at weekends, usually not. Sector 102 to Sector 113, including Godrej Summit, Sobha City and ATS Kocoon, sits far enough from the older corridors that a tutor finishing a lesson on Golf Course Road cannot reach you at a workable hour. Many families here run an online arrangement on two weeknights and keep a longer home class on Saturday morning. You lose a little of what a tutor notices in person, and you gain a slot that actually happens every week instead of one that keeps slipping.

mainEntity.name: My child finishes IGCSE Grade 10 this year and starts DP1. Same tutor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually not the same tutor, and that surprises families. The two stages are marked differently: IGCSE subjects are graded on Cambridge's A* to G scales or Edexcel's 9 to 1, with Core and Extended tiers in many Cambridge subjects, while DP subjects are graded 1 to 7 with Internal Assessment work and, at Higher Level, 240 recommended teaching hours against 150 at Standard Level. A tutor strong on Extended past papers is not automatically strong on IA criteria. Many households keep a subject tutor for the younger child and add a separate DP specialist for the older one.

mainEntity.name: How many sessions a week, and how soon can a tutor start?

acceptedAnswer.text: One to two sessions a week per subject is the common pattern, rising before mocks and the May session. Start dates depend on tutor availability and on how unusual your slot is: a six o'clock request in Sushant Lok 1 is easier to fill than an eight o'clock request in Sector 90. Send the query with your corridor, board, level and two possible evenings, and the shortlist comes back faster because nobody is guessing at your constraints. A demo or trial session is arranged before you commit to any regular arrangement.

mainEntity.name: What does the free trial class actually cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: Diagnosis, not a sales pitch. The tutor works through a few questions from the current unit, looks at the last marked paper or criterion sheet, and asks the student what they think is going wrong. You should come away with a short plan for the first month and a clear sense of whether those two people can work together at all. Use the trial to test the things that matter: does the tutor talk in the language of the mark scheme and the command terms, and do they know which exam series your school enters?

mainEntity.name: The tutor is not working out. What do we do now?

acceptedAnswer.text: Say so, and ask for a different match. Nothing about the arrangement is locked, and a private tutor who is wrong for your child is a wrong that compounds every week it continues. Be specific about what is failing: travel and lateness, board knowledge, pace, or simply that the student has stopped talking during sessions. That detail makes the next shortlist better rather than merely different. An IB IGCSE private tutor Gurgaon families book through IB Gram is matched on board, level and route together, so a mismatch in any one of the three is worth naming.

mainEntity.name: Is a home tutor worth the travel compared with a nearby coaching centre?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on what your child is losing marks for. A batch costs less per hour by structure, because the cost is shared, and a motivated student who mainly needs pace and company can do well inside one. A student who misreads command terms, or who needs IA criteria unpicked line by line, will not get that in a full room. Home tuition costs more in structure and buys attention plus a slot fixed around your own week. Neither answer is right for every family in Gurgaon, and the trial is what settles it.

mainEntity.name: We live in Manesar. Is a weekday home tutor realistic for us?

acceptedAnswer.text: Honestly, not often during term time. IMT Manesar, Hero Honda Chowk, Sector 33, Sector 34 and Sector 37 sit far from where most tutors hold their other lessons, so a weekday evening slot is hard to fill and harder to keep for a full term. An IB IGCSE private tutor Gurugram families book for this side usually works one of two ways: a long weekend session at home, or online on weeknights with home visits before mocks. Ask for both options in your query rather than only the one you would prefer.

Families arranging IB and IGCSE private tuition in Gurgaon usually start the same way any query does: a parent shares the board, syllabus, level, subjects and preferred format, home tuition, online lessons or a mix, through the site or a free consultation call. What makes it private is what happens after that: the tutor engaged is independent of the school entirely, chosen and agreed directly between the family and IB Gram, with no involvement from the student's teachers or the school administration.

The process runs through clear stages. 1. A shortlist of verified profiles is shared with the family, each matched to the exact syllabus and level needed. 3. A demo or trial session is arranged, and before it becomes a regular arrangement, the family and tutor agree in writing what the tuition covers: subjects, frequency, format and how progress will be shared.

Confidentiality matters more in a private arrangement than families sometimes expect. A tutor engaged privately should never discuss a student's specific difficulties with anyone at the school, and a family should say this plainly at the outset rather than assuming it is understood. This is different from a school's own remedial or extra classes, which sit inside the school's own record-keeping and are visible to the wider staff; private tuition through IB Gram is deliberately outside that system.

contentBlocks.heading: DP, MYP and IGCSE: the structure a private tutor works around
contentBlocks.body:
A private tutor working the IB Diploma Programme needs to understand its shape well enough to support it without duplicating it: two years, DP1 and DP2, six subjects across six groups, three or four at Higher Level and the remainder at Standard Level, each graded 1 to 7. Theory of Knowledge and the Extended Essay add up to three further points toward the 45-point maximum, with 24 as the minimum for the diploma, and Creativity, Activity, Service runs alongside the six subjects rather than earning points of its own. Most Gurgaon IB schools sit the May exam session, a minority use November, and each school fixes its own DP2 mock dates independently, usually months ahead of May; a private tutor should be working from these actual dates, shared by the family, whether the sessions run as home tuition or fully online, not a generic exam calendar.

The Middle Years Programme spans five years, MYP 1 to 5, across eight subject groups, with every subject marked against four criteria, A to D, each out of 8, converting through IB grade boundaries to a final 1 to 7 grade. Private tuition here usually supports the Personal Project in MYP 5, or the Community Project a year or two earlier, without ever producing the work itself, since that would cross directly into academic integrity territory the family should avoid entirely. Optional MYP eAssessment, where a school has opted in, adds on-screen exams and ePortfolios to what MYP 5 involves.

Cambridge IGCSE and Pearson Edexcel International GCSE usually run as a two-year course across Grade 9 and Grade 10, often followed by the IB DP, A Levels, or a move to CBSE or ISC for Class 11, and a private tutor who also understands the IGCSE to IB DP transition can support a family through that specific handover well. Cambridge sits exam series in February and March, an option available only in India, plus May, June, October and November, grading most syllabuses A star to G; Edexcel International GCSE grades everything 9 to 1. Core and Extended tier decisions, made with the school, shape what private tuition should focus on months ahead of the exam series, not the week before.

contentBlocks.heading: Mapping lessons to the syllabus without doing the school's own work
contentBlocks.body:
A private tutor's job is to build the student's own understanding against the real syllabus, never to complete school tasks on the student's behalf. For the IB Diploma Programme, that starts with command terms: define, describe, explain, evaluate, discuss and to what extent each demand a different depth of answer, and a private tutor should be teaching a student to recognise which term is being asked for, not handing over a model answer to copy. Past papers, mark schemes and subject reports, sourced through the school or the IB's own official channels, are the material a private tutor should mark a student's own attempt against, session after session.

For the Middle Years Programme, mapping means fluency with the four assessment criteria, A through D, each scored 0 to 8, so a private tutor can show a student exactly where a criterion was missed, such as reflection in Criterion D of a Sciences task, rather than simply saying an answer was not good enough. Coursework and the Personal Project deserve particular care here: a private tutor can discuss structure, process and how to interpret feedback, but writing or substantially editing the work itself crosses a line every family engaging private tuition should understand clearly from the start.

For Cambridge IGCSE and Pearson Edexcel International GCSE, mapping to the syllabus means knowing whether the student sits Core or Extended tier, or the Foundation or Higher equivalent, since this decision, made with the school, determines what ceiling a private tutor should be preparing the student to reach. Annotated past papers marked against the real scheme, not a generic worksheet, remain the most useful material regardless of board, whether taught as home tuition or online.

A private tutor who keeps to this boundary, teaching the method rather than producing the output, builds a student's own exam skill in a way that shows up in school tests independently of the tutor, which is ultimately the point of the arrangement.

contentBlocks.heading: Home tuition, online lessons or hybrid: choosing the private arrangement that fits your home?
contentBlocks.body:
Home tuition is the arrangement most families picture when they think of private tuition, and it remains IB Gram's lead service: an independent tutor at the family's own table in Sector 43 or South City 1, working from the student's actual notebook, with no one else from the school involved. For a family wanting maximum discretion and a tutor who reads the student's mood as well as their maths working, a fixed weekly home slot is usually the simplest private arrangement and needs the least explaining to the student.

Online private tuition works differently but is still entirely private and independent: a shared whiteboard, an annotated past paper on screen and a document camera for working let a specialist teach IB Chemistry HL or IGCSE Maths from anywhere, useful for a family on Dwarka Expressway or in Manesar where a private tutor with the right subject depth may not have a home slot free nearby. The honest trade-off is presence: an online tutor cannot lean over to check a working line the way a tutor at the table can, and a student who drifts easily needs more self-discipline to get full value from an online hour.

Hybrid arrangements, home most weeks with a switch to online during exam-heavy stretches or a bad traffic evening, work well for many families and keep the same tutor throughout, which matters for a private, confidential relationship built over a term rather than restarted with someone new each time the schedule gets difficult.

Whichever format, the private nature of the arrangement stays constant: no report goes to the school, no other student's data is shared, and the tutor works only for this family, on terms this family and the tutor agreed together at the start.

contentBlocks.heading: How is a private tutor different from your child's own school teacher?
contentBlocks.body:
Families researching IB and IGCSE private tuition in Gurgaon should expect this same conflict-of-interest check every time, whichever tutor they are eventually matched with. An outside private tutor and a school teacher running extra classes are not the same arrangement, even when the subject and student are identical. A school teacher's extra class usually happens on school premises, inside the school's own record-keeping, and is visible to other staff and sometimes other students; private tuition through IB Gram happens on the family's own terms, at home or online, with nothing shared back to the school. Before matching a family, IB Gram checks a tutor's board experience, actual level and subjects taught, and confirms there is no existing teaching relationship with the student's own school that would create a conflict of interest, particularly ruling out the student's own current class teacher.

Confidentiality is a real, checkable part of verification, not a vague promise: a private tutor should be able to state plainly that a student's specific difficulties, and even the fact that tuition is happening at all, stay between the family and the tutor. Families should ask this directly during the first consultation and again during the trial session, and a tutor who answers vaguely is worth being cautious about.

Academic mapping matters too: a private tutor should be checked on whether they can work from the school's own scheme of work, where the family can share it, without needing the school's involvement to do so. A tutor comfortable working from past papers, mark schemes and subject reports available through the school or the IB's own official channels, rather than a generic outline, is doing the job home tuition is actually for, whichever format the family chose.

If verification later turns out to be wrong, a shared teaching relationship comes to light, or confidentiality is not respected, families can end the arrangement and ask for a different match immediately.

contentBlocks.heading: What makes a tuition arrangement genuinely private and independent?
contentBlocks.body:
Private, in this context, means three specific things, not a vague sense of exclusivity: the tutor is engaged directly by the family rather than assigned by the school, the arrangement is confidential, and it operates entirely separately from anything the student's own teachers are doing. A private tutor who also happens to teach at the student's school, in a different subject or a different year group, is not automatically a conflict, but a tutor who is the student's own current class teacher for the subject being tutored is, since it raises a fair question about impartial marking of the student's regular schoolwork, whatever the individual teacher's actual conduct.

Mapping lessons to the school's scheme of work without doing school tasks is the clearest boundary in a private arrangement, and it is worth stating explicitly at the start rather than discovering it mid-term. A private tutor should teach a student how to structure an essay, how to approach an Internal Assessment, or how to revise for a specific paper, but should not write the essay, complete the Internal Assessment, or produce homework the student then submits as their own. Families sometimes ask for more than this under time pressure, close to a deadline, and a tutor who agrees crosses into academic integrity territory that risks the student directly, not just the arrangement. This boundary applies identically whether the arrangement is home tuition or a fully online one.

Confidentiality should be explicit, not assumed: a written note, even a short one exchanged over messages, stating that the tutor will not discuss the student's specific difficulties with anyone at the school, and that any materials shared stay between the family and tutor, protects both sides and sets clear expectations from the first session.

What to agree in writing before the first regular session: subjects and level, weekly frequency and preferred slot, format, home, online or hybrid, how progress updates will be shared, and confidentiality. None of this needs to be a formal contract; a clear message thread both sides can refer back to is usually enough, but leaving it unstated is where private arrangements most often run into trouble later.

contentBlocks.heading: What should progress at home look like, and how is confidentiality kept?
contentBlocks.body:
Whether arranged as IB and IGCSE private tuition in Gurgaon or fully online, progress checkpoints look similar and confidentiality expectations do not change. A fair first checkpoint for a private tutor, at home or online, sits around four to six sessions in, not the first lesson. By then a parent should see the tutor working from the student's actual school notes and recent test papers, and the student should be able to name one thing they now understand better than a month ago. No tutor can guarantee a grade, and a private tutor who implies otherwise, precisely because there is no school oversight of the claim, deserves more scrutiny, not less.

Confidentiality should hold quietly throughout the arrangement: the tutor does not mention the tuition to school staff, does not discuss the student's specific weaknesses outside the family, and keeps any shared materials, past papers, notes, mock scripts, between the family and themselves. If a family later learns a tutor has discussed the arrangement or the student's performance with someone at the school, that is a serious breach worth ending the relationship over, not a minor lapse to overlook.

Progress is genuinely slower in some situations, and a private tutor should say so honestly rather than promising steady improvement regardless of circumstance: a student starting close to mocks has less runway than one starting at the beginning of the year, and a student moving from CBSE mid-course into IGCSE or IB needs real time to adjust to command terms and criterion-based marking before subject progress becomes visible.

Parents should expect a short private update after each block of sessions, what was covered, what is still shaky, what comes next, shared only with the family, never routed through or copied to the school in any form.

contentBlocks.heading: Starting private tuition in Gurgaon: the practical first steps
contentBlocks.body:
Families arranging IB and IGCSE private tuition in Gurgaon should send a query through the site or book a free consultation, and share the board, syllabus, level, subjects and roughly which Gurgaon corridor the family is in, along with whether home, online or hybrid is preferred. IB Gram asks a few more questions to rule out any conflict of interest with the student's own school before shortlisting.

Once verified, independent profiles are shared, a demo or trial session is arranged, and before regular sessions begin, the family and tutor should agree in writing, even a short message thread is enough, what the arrangement covers: subjects, frequency, slot, format, how progress updates will be shared, and confidentiality. Getting this in writing early avoids the awkward conversation later where one side assumed something the other did not.

For the first session, it helps to have the student's recent school notes, test papers and a sense of the school's own upcoming deadlines ready to share, so the tutor is working from the actual situation rather than a generic starting point. A quiet space for the hour, at home or for an online session, matters more than anything elaborate.

If the first tutor is not the right fit, whether on pace, subject depth or how well the confidentiality conversation went, the family can ask for a different match, subject to tutor availability, and start the written agreement fresh with the new tutor, whichever the family eventually settles on, home tutoring, online lessons or hybrid, rather than assuming it carries over.

faqs.question: What makes tuition genuinely private rather than just any tutor?
faqs.answer: Private tuition means the tutor is engaged directly by the family, independent of the school, and the arrangement is confidential: nothing about the student's difficulties or the fact that tuition is happening goes back to the school. IB Gram also checks that the tutor has no existing teaching relationship with the student's current school that would raise a conflict of interest. This differs from a school's own extra classes, which sit inside the school's own record-keeping and are visible to other staff.

faqs.question: Can my child's own school teacher be their private tutor?
faqs.answer: No, IB Gram does not match a family with a student's own current class teacher for the subject being tutored, since it raises a fair question about impartial marking of the student's regular schoolwork, whatever the individual teacher's actual conduct. A teacher from a different subject or year group is not automatically ruled out, but any existing teaching relationship with the student's school is checked before a profile reaches the family. Families arranging tuition independently of IB Gram should ask this question directly themselves.

faqs.question: Will the school find out we have hired a private tutor?
faqs.answer: Not through IB Gram or the tutor; the arrangement is confidential by design, and a private tutor should never discuss a student's tuition or specific difficulties with anyone at the school. Families should state this expectation plainly at the first consultation rather than assume it is automatically understood. If confidentiality is ever broken, that is a serious issue worth ending the arrangement over, and families should raise it with IB Gram immediately rather than letting it continue quietly.

faqs.question: Can a private tutor help with IB coursework or the Internal Assessment?
faqs.answer: Yes, with guidance on structure, process and how to interpret feedback, but not by writing or substantially editing the work itself, since that crosses directly into academic integrity territory that risks the student, not just the arrangement. A private tutor should teach a student how to approach an Internal Assessment or Extended Essay, then step back while the student produces it. Families under time pressure close to a deadline should still hold this line, however tempting it feels to ask for more.

faqs.question: What should be agreed in writing before private tuition starts?
faqs.answer: Subjects and level, weekly frequency and preferred slot, format, home, online or hybrid, how progress updates will be shared, and confidentiality, all agreed before regular sessions begin. This does not need to be a formal contract; a short message thread both sides can refer back to is usually enough, though skipping this step is where private arrangements most often run into disagreement later. IB Gram encourages this conversation directly after the trial session, once both sides know the arrangement is going ahead.

faqs.question: How much does private IB or IGCSE tuition cost in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: Cost depends on the board, level, subject and weekly frequency, so there is no single figure across an IB DP2 student and an IGCSE Grade 9 student. IB Gram discusses the fee structure, priced by session, month or package, once the board, level and slot are confirmed during the first consultation, rather than quoting a number in advance. Private tuition is agreed directly between the family and tutor, so the structure should be settled clearly, in writing, before regular sessions begin.

faqs.question: Does a private tutor travel to Sector 82 or other New Gurgaon societies?
faqs.answer: It depends on the individual tutor's own route and existing students nearby; New Gurgaon, covering Sector 82 to Sector 90, Kherki Daula and Pataudi Road, is newer and less congested but sits further from where many independent tutors are based. Families here should ask directly during matching whether a prospective tutor already teaches nearby, since that usually means a more reliable weekly slot than one commuting in for a single student. Online private tuition is a realistic alternative if a suitable home tutor is not available nearby.

faqs.question: My child's private tutor is not respecting confidentiality. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Raise it directly with IB Gram straight away; this is treated as a serious issue, not a minor complaint, and the arrangement can be ended immediately if confidentiality has genuinely been broken. A replacement tutor can be shortlisted using the same board, level and slot details already on file, so the family does not need to start the whole matching process again from scratch. Families should also revisit the written agreement with any new tutor to restate the confidentiality expectation clearly.

faqs.question: Is private tuition at home better than a coaching centre for IB or IGCSE?
faqs.answer: Neither is automatically better; it depends on what the student needs. Private tuition offers full individual attention, confidentiality and lessons matched exactly to the syllabus and tier, while a coaching centre batch can cost less per hour and suits a student who studies well surrounded by peers. A family should weigh how much individual pacing the student actually needs against cost and whether privacy about the student's specific difficulties matters to the household.

faqs.question: Can private tuition run at home in the evening on a weekday in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is IB Gram's most common arrangement, though the realistic slot depends heavily on the corridor: a family on Sohna Road or Dwarka Expressway should build in more buffer time for evening traffic than a family in Sushant Lok or DLF Phases 2 to 4, which sit more centrally. Society gate registration also adds a few minutes to most home visits, worth mentioning to the tutor if discretion about the arrangement matters to the family.

faqs.question: What happens in the first private tuition session?
faqs.answer: The first session is usually a diagnostic look at the student's current work: recent tests, school notes and, where relevant, past papers, so the tutor can see where the student actually stands rather than assuming from the syllabus alone. It also doubles as the trial the family uses to judge fit before agreeing to a regular weekly arrangement. By the end, the tutor should be able to describe roughly what the first month will focus on.

contentBlocks.heading: How does IB Gram match you to an online IB or IGCSE tutor in Gurgaon?
contentBlocks.body:
Families searching for an IB and IGCSE online tutor in Gurgaon, sometimes typed as near me, usually start with a query through the site or a free consultation call, and the first exchange is less about the syllabus name and more about the evening: which corridor the family lives in, what the student's school timetable looks like this term, and whether the household wants lessons at home, online or a mix of both. IB Gram asks about the board, the syllabus, Cambridge, Pearson Edexcel or the IB's own MYP and DP subject guides, the level, the school's own scheme of work where the family knows it, and the slot that actually survives a busy week, not the slot that looks good on paper.

From there the process runs in clear steps, and each one narrows the shortlist further. 1. IB Gram reviews board experience, subject depth and, where it matters, whether the tutor already knows the pacing of schools common in the family's corridor, and shortlists profiles whose verification is complete. 2. The family is shown a short set of matched profiles rather than one name, with a note on why each one fits the brief, and picks who to try first. 3. A demo or trial session is arranged, online or at home depending on what the family asked for, before anyone commits to a term.

An online-first request changes what the shortlist looks for. A tutor with a strong home tuition record in DLF Phase 5 might never have taught a single online lesson, while a specialist who lives an hour from Sohna Road but teaches IB Physics online every evening can be exactly right for a family there. Matching for an online tutor therefore weighs screen comfort, how the tutor uses a shared whiteboard or annotated past paper, and whether they can hold a teenager's attention through a ninety-minute session without the physical presence a home lesson gives for free.

If the first match is not right, the family can ask for a different tutor. IB Gram does not lock a household into one profile after a single trial, because a mismatch in teaching pace or personality shows up quickly online, sometimes faster than it would at the kitchen table, and waiting it out rarely helps the student.

2. IB Gram checks board experience, subject depth and school familiarity before shortlisting profiles.

4. A demo or trial session runs online or at home before any commitment is made.

contentBlocks.heading: IB DP, MYP and IGCSE: what changes as a student moves up
contentBlocks.body:
The International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme is a two-year course, DP1 and DP2, built from six subjects across six groups. Three or four sit at Higher Level (HL, 240 recommended teaching hours) and the rest at Standard Level (SL, 150 hours), each graded 1 to 7. Theory of Knowledge (TOK) and the Extended Essay (EE) add up to 3 more points between them, so the maximum score is 45, with 24 as the minimum for the diploma itself, subject to the IB's own failing conditions, and Creativity, Activity, Service (CAS) sits alongside the academic subjects rather than earning points. Most Gurgaon IB schools sit the May exam session, though a minority use November, and DP2 mock examinations are set by each school, usually months ahead of May.

The Middle Years Programme runs five years, MYP 1 to 5, roughly ages 11 to 16, across eight subject groups. Every subject is marked against four criteria, A to D, each out of 8, and the criterion total out of 32 converts to a final grade of 1 to 7 through the IB's grade boundaries. MYP 5 brings the Personal Project, the Community Project sits in MYP 3 or 4 instead, and some schools also offer optional MYP eAssessment in MYP 5, on-screen exams plus ePortfolios, though this is a school choice, not a requirement.

Cambridge IGCSE and Pearson Edexcel International GCSE both usually run as a two-year course across Grade 9 and Grade 10 in Gurgaon, often followed by the IB DP, A Levels, or a move into CBSE or ISC for Class 11. A tutor who also handles the IGCSE to IB DP transition well can keep real continuity for a family moving from Grade 10 straight into DP1, rather than starting from zero with a new tutor. Cambridge runs exam series in February and March, offered only in India among the main series, May and June, and October and November, and grades most syllabuses A star to G, with 9-1 versions of some syllabuses under separate codes. Edexcel International GCSE grades 9 to 1 throughout. Many Cambridge subjects split into Core and Extended tiers, and this decision, made with the school, shapes what an online tutor should focus revision on well before the exam series.

An online IB and IGCSE tutor working across these programmes needs to hold the right pacing in their head for each one, since a DP2 student six weeks from mocks needs a different rhythm from an MYP 2 student still building criterion-based habits.
items: IB DP: six subjects, HL and SL split, TOK and EE add up to 3 points.
IB MYP: eight subject groups marked against four criteria, A to D, each out of 8.
Cambridge IGCSE: Core tops out at grade C, Extended reaches A star.
Pearson Edexcel International GCSE grades every subject on a 9 to 1 scale.
Most Gurgaon IB schools use the May exam session; a minority use November.

contentBlocks.heading: Subject depth: papers, components and command terms an online tutor should know
contentBlocks.body:
An online lesson lives or dies on whether the tutor can get inside the actual mark scheme, not just the topic. For the IB Diploma Programme, that means working from the command terms that set how deep an answer needs to go: define, describe, explain, evaluate, discuss and to what extent each ask for a different length and structure of response, and an HL Economics essay marked against evaluate fails for different reasons than one marked against explain. Past papers, mark schemes and subject reports come through the school or the IB's own official channels, and a good online tutor uses these directly on screen, marking a student's own attempt against the real scheme rather than a generic rubric.

For the Middle Years Programme, subject depth means fluency with the four assessment criteria, A through D, each scored 0 to 8, because a student can write confidently and still lose marks against a criterion they never addressed, such as reflection in Criterion D of a Sciences task. A tutor working MYP 5 also needs to know whether the school has opted into MYP eAssessment, since on-screen exams and ePortfolios change how a term is paced compared with a school running only internal assessment.

For Cambridge IGCSE, the Core and Extended tier decision shapes revision months before the exam series: Core tops out at grade C, Extended reaches A star, and moving a student between tiers late in Grade 10 is a real conversation with the school, not a tutor's call to make alone. Pearson Edexcel International GCSE grades every subject 9 to 1 without a tiered split in the same way, which changes how a tutor sequences past papers across the two years. Whichever board, an online tutor should be working from annotated past papers on a shared screen, marking against the real scheme, session after session, rather than reteaching content the student has already covered in class.

Getting subject depth right online is partly about tools: a shared whiteboard, a document camera or a scanned answer script make it possible to mark handwriting nearly the same way a tutor would lean over a desk to do at home, which matters for Maths, Physics and Chemistry especially, where method marks depend on visible steps rather than just the final answer.
items: Command terms like evaluate and discuss set how deep an IB DP answer needs to go.
MYP criteria A to D each score 0 to 8 and convert to a final 1-7 grade.
Cambridge Core tops out at grade C; Extended reaches A star.
Edexcel International GCSE grades every subject 9 to 1, without the same tier split.
Annotated past papers on a shared screen replace the desk-side marking of a home lesson.

contentBlocks.heading: School calendars across Gurgaon's international schools, and what changes each term

Families at schools such as Pathways World School, Aravali, Pathways School Gurgaon, Lancers International School, Scottish High International School, GD Goenka World School, Heritage Xperiential Learning School, The Shri Ram School, Aravali and DPS International Edge run through broadly the same academic rhythm each year, even though every school sets its own dates. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named here, the International Baccalaureate, Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel; naming schools only describes the calendar pressures families in Gurgaon deal with in general. Whatever the exact phrase used, an international board tutor Gurugram families search for usually means support across one of these same programmes.

A school year built around an international board usually opens with a settling-in period, moves into unit tests and internal assessments through the first term, and builds toward school-set mock examinations well before the actual exam series. For DP2 students, mocks typically land some months ahead of the May session, and the gap between a mock result and the real exam is often the busiest stretch of online tutoring a family will book all year. For MYP and IGCSE students, coursework deadlines, practical assessments and, in some subjects, oral or speaking components sit alongside regular unit tests, and a tutor arranging home tuition or teaching online around this calendar needs the actual dates, not a generic one.

Winter break, board exam leave and the run-up to report cards each pull attention away from tuition for a week or two, and an online tutor who expects a family to keep a fixed weekly slot through all of it will find sessions cancelled anyway. A more realistic plan treats the calendar as three or four blocks a year, each with its own intensity: settling in, building through unit tests, stepping up before mocks, and revising hard in the weeks before the exam series itself.

contentBlocks.heading: Home tuition, online classes or hybrid: what actually suits a Gurgaon household?
contentBlocks.body:
Home tuition is IB Gram's lead service on every one of these searches, including this one: a verified tutor sits at the family's own table in Sector 57 or South City 1, works from the student's actual notebook, and reads the room in a way a screen cannot always manage, especially with a younger or easily distracted student. For a family close to the tutor's own route, on a corridor like Sushant Lok or DLF Phases 2 to 4, a fixed weekly home slot is usually the simplest option and needs the least setup.

Online lessons for IB and IGCSE students work differently and, for the keyword this page answers, are often the more practical call. A shared whiteboard, an annotated past paper on screen and a document camera for handwritten working let a specialist teach IB Maths AA HL or IGCSE Physics from anywhere, which matters enormously for a family on Dwarka Expressway or in Manesar trying to book a specialist who may not have a home slot free anywhere near them. The honest trade-off: an online tutor cannot physically point at a diagram the way a tutor at the table can, and a student who is easily distracted by their own phone or a second screen needs more discipline to get full value from an online hour. When families compare IB and IGCSE tutors in Gurgaon side by side, whether at home or online, the same four questions decide most of it: board fit, level fit, slot and school familiarity.

Hybrid arrangements, where a tutor visits at home most weeks and switches online during exam-heavy stretches or bad traffic evenings, suit many families across Golf Course Road, Golf Course Extension Road and Sohna Road particularly well, since it keeps the relationship a student is used to while adding flexibility exactly when the calendar gets difficult.

The right call usually comes down to two questions: how far the family's corridor sits from where suitable specialists are actually based, and how well the specific student concentrates without someone physically in the room. A family should say honestly during matching which of the two, attention or access to a specialist, matters more this term, because IB Gram weighs the shortlist differently depending on the answer.

contentBlocks.heading: How IB Gram verifies a tutor before the first online session
contentBlocks.body:
Before a profile reaches a family's shortlist, IB Gram checks a tutor's board experience against what they claim: which programme and level they have actually taught, which subjects, and for how long, rather than accepting a headline description at face value. Academic background is checked against the qualification the tutor has stated, and any claimed experience with a specific syllabus, Cambridge, Pearson Edexcel or an IB subject guide, is checked before the profile is shown to any family. This checking applies equally whether the arrangement ends up being home tuition or a fully online one.

For an online tutor specifically, verification also covers whether they can actually teach through a screen: comfort with a shared whiteboard, ability to mark handwritten working through a document camera or scanned image, and whether their own setup, a stable connection and a quiet, well-lit space, holds up across a full session rather than dropping out halfway through an explanation. A tutor who is excellent in person but has never taught a live online lesson is not automatically a fit for an online-first request, even with strong subject knowledge.

Families searching for the best IB and IGCSE online tutor in Gurgaon are usually asking what evidence to check, not for a ranking, since no independent authority scores individual tutors in India. Parents should still check things for themselves that a platform cannot fully verify from a distance: ask for a short trial or demo before committing to a term, ask how the tutor plans to use past papers and mark schemes on screen, and ask directly how they handle a student who has stopped engaging, since disengagement is harder to spot through a screen than across a table.

If a tutor's actual teaching does not match what verification suggested, families can ask for a different match, and this is treated as normal course correction rather than a complaint that needs to be justified at length.

Online-specific checks cover whiteboard comfort, connection stability and screen presence.

contentBlocks.heading: The screen setup that makes an online lesson actually work
contentBlocks.body:
An online IB or IGCSE lesson depends on tools most families already own, used properly, more than on anything expensive. A laptop or tablet with a stable camera, a second device or a printed copy of the working sheet so the student is not squinting at a shared screen for an entire session, and a headset or earphones with a working microphone matter more than any subject-specific software. A shared digital whiteboard lets a tutor sketch a Physics diagram, work through an IB Maths AA proof step by step, or annotate an IGCSE Chemistry equation live, in much the same way they would on paper at a family's table in DLF Phase 5.

For written subjects, a document camera or a phone propped to face downward over the desk lets a tutor watch a student's actual handwriting and working, which matters for Maths, Physics and Chemistry especially, where method marks depend on visible steps, not just the final answer. Annotated past papers, marked up together on screen against the real Cambridge, Edexcel or IB scheme, are worth more online than any generic worksheet, because the student sees exactly how an examiner would read their own script.

Some work suits a screen less well: a TOK discussion or an EE supervision meeting can run online without much loss, since these are largely conversation, but a student who needs someone to physically check a lab notebook or correct handwriting posture may do better with a home tutor for that particular piece of work. Younger students in MYP 1 or 2 also tend to concentrate better with someone at the table, at least until they are used to how an online lesson runs.

Honest limits matter here. A patchy internet connection on some Gurgaon evenings, especially further out on Dwarka Expressway or in New Gurgaon during heavy rain, can break the flow of a session in a way a home lesson never would, and families booking online should have a backup plan, a phone hotspot or a rescheduled slot, rather than losing the lesson entirely.

A document camera lets a tutor check handwritten working the same way as at home.
